```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(terra)
  library(leaflet)
})

case_dir <- normalizePath("../port_fairy/output", mustWork = TRUE)
# The normal forecast writes support files under site/assets. Historical runs
# set PORT_FAIRY_SITE_DIR to an isolated report folder so their maps/assets do
# not overwrite the live report's equivalents.
report_site_dir <- normalizePath(
  file.path("..", Sys.getenv("PORT_FAIRY_SITE_DIR", unset = "site")),
  mustWork = FALSE
)
results_dir <- file.path(case_dir, "results")
forcing <- read.csv(file.path(case_dir, "latest_buoy_forcing.csv"),
                    check.names = FALSE)
grid <- read.csv(file.path(case_dir, "grid_metadata.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
if (nrow(forcing) != 1 || nrow(grid) != 1) {
  stop("Expected one row in forcing and grid metadata files.")
}
if (!is.finite(grid$dx_m[1]) || !is.finite(grid$dy_m[1]) ||
    !is.finite(grid$total_time_s[1]) || !is.finite(grid$plot_intv_s[1]) ||
    grid$dx_m[1] <= 0 || grid$dy_m[1] <= 0 ||
    grid$total_time_s[1] <= 0 || grid$plot_intv_s[1] <= 0) {
  stop("Grid metadata must contain positive dx_m, dy_m, total_time_s and plot_intv_s values.")
}
metres_label <- function(x) {
  # Strip decimal zeroes, not meaningful integer zeroes: the previous helper
  # turned 200 into "2", which mislabelled the Umean/Vmean window as 2 s.
  out <- formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = 6)
  out <- sub("0+$", "", out)
  sub("\\.$", "", out)
}
public_output_dx_m <- if ("public_output_dx_m" %in% names(grid) &&
                          is.finite(grid$public_output_dx_m[1])) {
  grid$public_output_dx_m[1]
} else {
  max(10, grid$dx_m[1])
}
public_output_dy_m <- if ("public_output_dy_m" %in% names(grid) &&
                          is.finite(grid$public_output_dy_m[1])) {
  grid$public_output_dy_m[1]
} else {
  public_output_dx_m
}
public_output_factor_x <- public_output_dx_m / grid$dx_m[1]
public_output_factor_y <- public_output_dy_m / grid$dy_m[1]
if (public_output_factor_x < 1 || public_output_factor_y < 1 ||
    abs(public_output_factor_x - round(public_output_factor_x)) > 1e-8 ||
    abs(public_output_factor_y - round(public_output_factor_y)) > 1e-8) {
  stop("The requested public-output x/y resolutions must be integer multiples of the model x/y resolutions.")
}
public_output_factor_x <- as.integer(round(public_output_factor_x))
public_output_factor_y <- as.integer(round(public_output_factor_y))
grid_tag <- if ("grid_file_tag" %in% names(grid) &&
                nzchar(as.character(grid$grid_file_tag[1]))) {
  as.character(grid$grid_file_tag[1])
} else if (abs(grid$dx_m[1] - grid$dy_m[1]) < 1e-8) {
  paste0(metres_label(grid$dx_m[1]), "m")
} else {
  paste0(metres_label(grid$dx_m[1]), "m_x_", metres_label(grid$dy_m[1]), "m_y")
}
public_grid_tag <- paste0(metres_label(public_output_dx_m), "m x ",
                          metres_label(public_output_dy_m), "m")
simulation_minutes <- grid$total_time_s[1] / 60
final_sixth_start_s <- (5 / 6) * grid$total_time_s[1]
elapsed_clock <- function(elapsed_s) {
  sprintf("%02.0f:%02.0f", floor(elapsed_s / 60), round(elapsed_s %% 60))
}
simulation_label <- paste0(sprintf("%.0f", simulation_minutes), "-minute")
final_sixth_start_label <- elapsed_clock(final_sixth_start_s)
simulation_end_label <- elapsed_clock(grid$total_time_s[1])
eta_display_limits <- c(-5, 5)
eta_max_display_limits <- c(0, 5)
hsig_display_limits <- c(0, 6)
ygnbu_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlGnBu")
# Station 1 is the buoy/offshore end. Use the perceptually ordered Magma
# sequence, from black-purple offshore to pale yellow at the beach end.
# These fixed Magma samples avoid adding another R package.
station_colours <- c("#000004", "#51127C", "#B5367A", "#FB8861", "#FCFDBF")
eta_animation_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(ygnbu_palette)(100)

pretty_field_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- tools::toTitleCase(x)
  x <- gsub("\\bFunwave\\b", "FUNWAVE", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bHs\\b", "Hs", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bTp\\b", "Tp", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bMglob\\b", "Mglob", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bNglob\\b", "Nglob", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bDx\\b", "DX", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bDy\\b", "DY", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bWk\\b", "WK", x)
  x
}

transpose_summary <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (nrow(x) != 1) stop("transpose_summary() expects a one-row data frame.")
  data.frame(
    Item = pretty_field_name(names(x)),
    Value = vapply(x[1, ], function(value) {
      if (is.numeric(value)) format(value, digits = digits, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE) else as.character(value)
    }, character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

report_table <- function(x, digits = 2, summary = NULL) {
  table_html <- paste(
    knitr::kable(x, format = "html", digits = digits, escape = TRUE,
                 table.attr = 'class="pf-report-table"'),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  if (is.null(summary)) {
    summary <- paste0("Show ", nrow(as.data.frame(x)), "-row table")
  }
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(
    '<details class="pf-report-table-details"><summary>',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(summary),
    '</summary>', table_html, '</details>'
  ))
}

# The buoys report UTC. Show the animation using Port Fairy's local civil time
# while retaining the model's elapsed time from that observation.
port_fairy_tz <- "Australia/Melbourne"
buoy_time_utc <- as.POSIXct(
  sub(" UTC$", "", forcing$time_utc[1]),
  format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"
)
if (is.na(buoy_time_utc)) stop("Could not parse the buoy observation time.")

# FUNWAVE writes text grids as Nglob rows (model y) by Mglob columns (model x).
# R's image() expects z[x, y], so transpose every model output exactly once.
as_model_xy <- function(z, label = "model field") {
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  if (all(dim(z) == c(grid$Nglob, grid$Mglob))) return(t(z))
  if (all(dim(z) == c(grid$Mglob, grid$Nglob))) return(z)
  stop(sprintf("%s has %.0f x %.0f values; expected %.0f x %.0f (y x x).",
               label, nrow(z), ncol(z), grid$Nglob, grid$Mglob))
}

read_text_model <- function(path, label = basename(path)) {
  as_model_xy(utils::read.table(path, header = FALSE), label)
}

read_field <- function(prefix, directory = results_dir) {
  candidates <- list.files(directory, pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "_[0-9]{5}$"),
                           full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(candidates)) return(NULL)
  number <- as.integer(sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_"), "", basename(candidates)))
  read_text_model(candidates[which.max(number)], prefix)
}


read_all_fields <- function(prefix, directory = results_dir) {
  candidates <- list.files(directory, pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "_[0-9]{5}$"),
                           full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(candidates)) return(list())
  number <- as.integer(sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_"), "", basename(candidates)))
  candidates <- candidates[order(number)]
  lapply(candidates, read_text_model, label = prefix)
}

maximum_model_field <- function(fields) {
  if (!length(fields)) return(NULL)
  out <- fields[[1]]
  if (length(fields) > 1) {
    for (k in 2:length(fields)) out <- pmax(out, fields[[k]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
  out
}

read_static_model <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(results_dir, name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_text_model(path, name)
}

model_axes <- function(z) {
  list(x = (seq_len(nrow(z)) - 1) * grid$dx_m,
       y = (seq_len(ncol(z)) - 1) * grid$dy_m)
}

plot_model <- function(z, main, col, zlim = range(z, finite = TRUE), ...) {
  a <- model_axes(z)
  image(a$x, a$y, z, asp = 1, col = col, zlim = zlim,
        xlab = "Model x: source edge to coast (m)",
        ylab = "Model y (m)", main = main, ...)
  invisible(a)
}

model_to_rotated_raster <- function(z, label = "model field") {
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  expected <- c(grid$Mglob, grid$Nglob)
  if (!identical(dim(z), expected)) {
    stop(sprintf("%s has %.0f x %.0f values; expected Mglob x Nglob = %.0f x %.0f.",
                 label, nrow(z), ncol(z), expected[1], expected[2]))
  }

  # z is [model x, model y]. Convert it back to terra's native
  # [north-to-south row, west-to-east column] layout using the exact inverse
  # of the transforms in setup_port_fairy_funwave.R.
  gis_rows <- t(z)
  if (source_is_low_x) {
    gis_rows <- gis_rows[nrow(gis_rows):1, , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    gis_rows <- gis_rows[, ncol(gis_rows):1, drop = FALSE]
  }

  out <- rast(depth_raster)
  values(out) <- as.vector(t(gis_rows))
  out
}

# Convert an Omerc raster back to model [x, y] order. This is the inverse of
# model_to_rotated_raster() and is also used to derive the maximum-eta wetting
# mask from the original DEM before any WGS84 projection.
rotated_raster_to_model_xy <- function(r_om) {
  gis_rows <- terra::as.matrix(r_om, wide = TRUE)
  if (source_is_low_x) {
    t(gis_rows[nrow(gis_rows):1, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    t(gis_rows[, ncol(gis_rows):1, drop = FALSE])
  }
}

symmetric_raster_limits <- function(r) {
  m <- global(abs(r), "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  if (!is.finite(m) || m == 0) m <- 1e-8
  c(-m, m)
}

write_model_output_rasters <- function(r_om, stem, method = "bilinear",
                                       already_public = FALSE) {
  # `make_public_output_rotated()` first masks native-grid values then
  # aggregates to the requested public resolution before any geographic
  # reprojection. This keeps output geometry consistent with the native 5 m
  # grid while retaining the maximum-eta inundation extent.
  if (!already_public) r_om <- make_public_output_rotated(r_om)
  writeRaster(r_om, file.path(case_dir, paste0(stem, "_rotated_omerc.tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE)
  r_ll <- project(r_om, "EPSG:4326", method = method)
  writeRaster(r_ll, file.path(case_dir, paste0(stem, "_wgs84.tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE)
  r_ll
}


symmetric_limits <- function(z) {
  m <- max(abs(z), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(m) || m == 0) m <- 1e-8
  c(-m, m)
}

positive_limits <- function(z) {
  m <- max(z, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(m) || m <= 0) m <- 1e-8
  c(0, m)
}

depth_raster <- rast(file.path(
  case_dir, paste0("depth_", grid_tag, "_positive_water_depth.tif")
))
elevation_raster <- rast(file.path(
  case_dir, paste0("elevation_", grid_tag, "_warped.tif")
))
depth_from_file <- read_text_model(file.path(case_dir, "depth.txt"), "depth.txt")
source_is_low_x <- identical(grid$source_edge, "minimum rotated x")

# Begin with the still-water DEM mask. Once all eta frames have been read this
# is replaced by the maximum-eta inundation mask below, still on the native
# rotated grid and before any WGS84 interpolation.
dem_water_model <- is.finite(depth_from_file) & depth_from_file > 0
dem_water_mask_rotated <- ifel(depth_raster > 0, 1, 0)
dem_water_mask_wgs84 <- project(dem_water_mask_rotated, "EPSG:4326", method = "near")
display_water_model <- dem_water_model
display_water_mask_rotated <- dem_water_mask_rotated
display_water_mask_wgs84 <- dem_water_mask_wgs84
display_water_mask_label <- "still-water DEM wet cells"

apply_display_water_mask_model <- function(z) {
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  z[!display_water_model] <- NA_real_
  z
}

apply_display_water_mask_rotated <- function(r_om) {
  r_om[is.na(display_water_mask_rotated) | display_water_mask_rotated <= 0] <- NA_real_
  r_om
}

# The internal wavemaker emits energy in both directions. The buoy-side side
# is intentionally hidden from coastal forecast products before projection and
# again afterwards, preventing interpolation from bleeding across the paddle.
shoreward_of_paddle_model <- outer(
  (seq_len(grid$Mglob[1]) - 1) * grid$dx_m[1], seq_len(grid$Nglob[1]),
  function(x, y) x >= grid$x_wk_m[1]
)
shoreward_of_paddle_rotated <- model_to_rotated_raster(
  ifelse(shoreward_of_paddle_model, 1, 0), "shoreward-of-wavemaker mask"
)
shoreward_of_paddle_wgs84 <- project(shoreward_of_paddle_rotated, "EPSG:4326", method = "near")

apply_output_visibility_mask_model <- function(z) {
  z <- apply_display_water_mask_model(z)
  z[!shoreward_of_paddle_model] <- NA_real_
  z
}

apply_output_visibility_mask_rotated <- function(r_om) {
  r_om <- apply_display_water_mask_rotated(r_om)
  r_om[is.na(shoreward_of_paddle_rotated) | shoreward_of_paddle_rotated <= 0] <- NA_real_
  r_om
}

make_public_output_rotated <- function(r_om) {
  r_om <- apply_output_visibility_mask_rotated(r_om)
  if (public_output_factor_x <= 1L && public_output_factor_y <= 1L) return(r_om)

  # A public cell is retained only where all contributing native cells are
  # inundated at any saved eta time and shoreward of the wavemaker. This keeps
  # WGS84 interpolation from leaking output across the coast or source side.
  visibility <- ifel(
    is.na(display_water_mask_rotated) | is.na(shoreward_of_paddle_rotated) |
      display_water_mask_rotated <= 0 | shoreward_of_paddle_rotated <= 0,
    0, 1
  )
  # Terra receives aggregation factors in raster row/column order: y then x.
  # The model factors are x then y, while terra receives raster row/column
  # factors as y then x.
  raster_aggregation_factors <- c(public_output_factor_y, public_output_factor_x)
  public_visibility <- aggregate(
    visibility, fact = raster_aggregation_factors, fun = min, na.rm = TRUE
  )
  r_om <- aggregate(r_om, fact = raster_aggregation_factors,
                     fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  r_om[is.na(public_visibility) | public_visibility <= 0] <- NA_real_
  r_om
}

# Reconstruct depth.txt on the exact native Omerc raster, then derive maps
# from that raster. This is the same pathway used for FUNWAVE outputs below.
depth_from_file_rotated <- model_to_rotated_raster(depth_from_file, "depth.txt")
depth_file_minus_raster <- depth_from_file_rotated - depth_raster
max_depth_file_delta <- global(abs(depth_file_minus_raster), "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]

buoy_ll <- vect(matrix(c(forcing$buoy_lon, forcing$buoy_lat), ncol = 2),
                type = "points", crs = "EPSG:4326")
buoy_om <- project(buoy_ll, crs(depth_raster))

# Plot all map products in WGS84, but only after reconstructing them on the
# native rotated grid. The black outline is the rectangular FUNWAVE domain.
outline_from_raster <- function(r) {
  vect(rbind(
    c(xmin(r), ymin(r)), c(xmax(r), ymin(r)),
    c(xmax(r), ymax(r)), c(xmin(r), ymax(r)),
    c(xmin(r), ymin(r))
  ), type = "polygons", crs = crs(r))
}
model_outline_om <- outline_from_raster(depth_raster)
model_outline_ll_xy <- crds(project(model_outline_om, "EPSG:4326"))

# Model x is always written from the buoy-side source edge toward the coast.
# Draw the actual internal-wavemaker line on every map so the reconstructed
# fields can be checked against their physical source location.
source_x_om <- if (source_is_low_x) {
  xmin(depth_raster) + grid$x_wk_m
} else {
  xmax(depth_raster) - grid$x_wk_m
}
# Use the actual source-line endpoints recorded by setup. The present case
# spans the full model y extent; the fallback keeps older output folders
# renderable when they lack the endpoint metadata.
source_y_first_model_m <- if ("source_y_first_cell_m" %in% names(grid)) {
  grid$source_y_first_cell_m[1]
} else {
  0
}
source_y_last_model_m <- if ("source_y_last_cell_m" %in% names(grid)) {
  grid$source_y_last_cell_m[1]
} else {
  (grid$Nglob[1] - 1) * grid$dy_m[1]
}
source_y_om <- if (source_is_low_x) {
  c(ymin(depth_raster) + source_y_first_model_m,
    ymin(depth_raster) + source_y_last_model_m)
} else {
  c(ymax(depth_raster) - source_y_first_model_m,
    ymax(depth_raster) - source_y_last_model_m)
}
source_line_om <- vect(rbind(
  c(source_x_om, source_y_om[1]),
  c(source_x_om, source_y_om[2])
), type = "lines", crs = crs(depth_raster))
source_line_ll_xy <- crds(project(source_line_om, "EPSG:4326"))

plot_geographic <- function(r_ll, ..., show_legend = FALSE, range = NULL,
                            animation = FALSE) {
  # terra::plot uses range= to fix its colour scale; zlim= is for image().
  if (animation) {
    old_par <- graphics::par(no.readonly = TRUE)
    on.exit(graphics::par(old_par), add = TRUE)
    # Reserve a real in-frame margin for the colour bar; earlier GIFs placed
    # it at the device edge where the labels could be clipped.
    graphics::par(mar = c(4.1, 4.2, 3.6, 8.8), xpd = FALSE)
    plot_legend <- list(cex = 0.72, shrink = 0.82)
    if (is.null(range)) {
      plot(r_ll, ..., plg = plot_legend)
    } else {
      plot(r_ll, ..., range = range, plg = plot_legend)
    }
  } else if (is.null(range)) {
    plot(r_ll, ...)
  } else {
    plot(r_ll, ..., range = range)
  }
  lines(model_outline_ll_xy[, 1], model_outline_ll_xy[, 2],
        col = "black", lwd = 2)
  lines(source_line_ll_xy[, 1], source_line_ll_xy[, 2],
        col = "dodgerblue3", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  points(crds(buoy_ll)[1, 1], crds(buoy_ll)[1, 2],
         pch = 16, col = "red", cex = 1.25)
  if (show_legend) {
    legend("bottomleft",
           legend = c("FUNWAVE grid", "internal wavemaker", "buoy"),
           col = c("black", "dodgerblue3", "red"), lwd = c(2, 2, NA),
           lty = c(1, 2, NA), pch = c(NA, NA, 16),
           bty = "n", cex = if (animation) 0.62 else 0.75,
           inset = if (animation) 0.012 else 0)
  }
}

local_map_bounds <- function(r_ll, padding = 0.04) {
  e <- ext(r_ll)
  x_pad <- (xmax(e) - xmin(e)) * padding
  y_pad <- (ymax(e) - ymin(e)) * padding
  c(west = xmin(e) - x_pad, south = ymin(e) - y_pad,
    east = xmax(e) + x_pad, north = ymax(e) + y_pad)
}

apply_water_masks_wgs84 <- function(r_ll) {
  water_mask <- display_water_mask_wgs84
  if (!compareGeom(water_mask, r_ll, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    water_mask <- resample(water_mask, r_ll, method = "near")
  }
  r_ll[is.na(water_mask) | water_mask <= 0] <- NA_real_

  paddle_mask <- shoreward_of_paddle_wgs84
  if (!compareGeom(paddle_mask, r_ll, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    paddle_mask <- resample(paddle_mask, r_ll, method = "near")
  }
  r_ll[is.na(paddle_mask) | paddle_mask <= 0] <- NA_real_

  r_ll
}

leaflet_model_map <- function(r_ll, palette, limits, legend_title,
                              bathymetry_r_ll = NULL,
                              bathymetry_palette = ygnbu_palette,
                              bathymetry_limits = NULL) {
  b <- local_map_bounds(r_ll, padding = 0.04)
  max_b <- local_map_bounds(r_ll, padding = 0.50)
  pal <- colorNumeric(palette = palette, domain = limits, na.color = "transparent")
  m <- leaflet(width = "100%", height = 480,
               options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 12, maxZoom = 18,
                                        maxBoundsViscosity = 1))
  # These public sources require no project key. Add imagery first, then
  # explicitly activate it after the layers control is built.
  m <- addProviderTiles(m, "Esri.WorldImagery", group = "Satellite imagery")
  m <- addProviderTiles(m, "OpenStreetMap.Mapnik", group = "OpenStreetMap")
  m <- setMaxBounds(m, max_b[["west"]], max_b[["south"]],
                    max_b[["east"]], max_b[["north"]])
  m <- fitBounds(m, b[["west"]], b[["south"]], b[["east"]], b[["north"]])
  has_bathymetry <- !is.null(bathymetry_r_ll)
  if (has_bathymetry) {
    if (is.null(bathymetry_limits)) {
      bathymetry_limits <- c(0, terra::global(bathymetry_r_ll, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1])
    }
    if (!all(is.finite(bathymetry_limits)) || bathymetry_limits[2] <= bathymetry_limits[1]) {
      bathymetry_limits <- c(0, 1)
    }
    bathy_pal <- colorNumeric(
      palette = bathymetry_palette, domain = bathymetry_limits,
      na.color = "transparent"
    )
    m <- addRasterImage(
      m, bathymetry_r_ll, colors = bathy_pal, opacity = 0.78, project = FALSE,
      group = "Bathymetry (water depth)"
    )
  }
  m <- addRasterImage(m, r_ll, colors = pal, opacity = 0.88, project = FALSE,
                      group = "Model output")
  m <- addPolylines(m, lng = model_outline_ll_xy[, 1], lat = model_outline_ll_xy[, 2],
                    color = "black", weight = 2, group = "FUNWAVE grid")
  m <- addPolylines(m, lng = source_line_ll_xy[, 1], lat = source_line_ll_xy[, 2],
                    color = "dodgerblue3", weight = 2, dashArray = "6 6",
                    group = "Internal wavemaker")
  m <- addCircleMarkers(m, lng = crds(buoy_ll)[1, 1], lat = crds(buoy_ll)[1, 2],
                        radius = 5, color = "red", fillOpacity = 1,
                        label = "Port Fairy wave buoy", group = "Buoy")
  if (exists("station_metadata", inherits = TRUE) && nrow(station_metadata)) {
    m <- addCircleMarkers(
      m, lng = station_metadata$lon, lat = station_metadata$lat,
      radius = 4, color = station_colours[seq_len(nrow(station_metadata))],
      fillOpacity = 1, label = station_metadata$station_id,
      group = "Transect stations"
    )
  }
  overlay_groups <- c(
    "Model output", "FUNWAVE grid", "Internal wavemaker", "Buoy", "Transect stations"
  )
  if (has_bathymetry) {
    overlay_groups <- c("Bathymetry (water depth)", overlay_groups)
  }
  m <- addLayersControl(
    m,
    baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap", "Satellite imagery"),
    overlayGroups = overlay_groups,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
  # Keep imagery active: hiding OpenStreetMap alone can leave a Leaflet radio
  # control with neither base layer selected in some browsers.
  m <- leaflet::hideGroup(m, "OpenStreetMap")
  m <- leaflet::showGroup(m, "Satellite imagery")
  if (has_bathymetry) {
    m <- leaflet::hideGroup(m, "Bathymetry (water depth)")
    m <- addLegend(
      m, position = "bottomleft", pal = bathy_pal, values = bathymetry_limits,
      title = "Bathymetry\nwater depth (m)", opacity = 0.88,
      group = "Bathymetry (water depth)"
    )
  }
  m <- addLegend(m, position = "bottomright", pal = pal, values = limits,
                 title = legend_title, opacity = 0.88)
  # Compact controls; line breaks in legend titles are preserved so the map
  # controls do not consume a large share of the local-domain view.
  m <- htmlwidgets::onRender(m, "
    function(el) {
      el.querySelectorAll('.info.legend').forEach(function(node) {
        node.style.maxWidth = '165px';
        node.style.whiteSpace = 'pre-line';
        node.style.lineHeight = '1.15';
      });
      el.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers').forEach(function(node) {
        node.style.maxWidth = '165px';
      });
      el.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers label').forEach(function(node) {
        node.style.whiteSpace = 'normal';
        node.style.display = 'block';
        node.style.lineHeight = '1.15';
      });
    }
  ")
  m
}

frame_local_time <- function(elapsed_s) {
  format(buoy_time_utc + elapsed_s, "%d %b %Y %H:%M %Z", tz = port_fairy_tz)
}

add_wave_frame_annotation <- function(r_ll, elapsed_s) {
  e <- ext(r_ll)
  x_span <- xmax(e) - xmin(e)
  y_span <- ymax(e) - ymin(e)
  bearing_to <- forcing$boundary_direction_to_deg_true[1]
  direction_statistic <- forcing$boundary_direction_statistic[1]
  angle <- bearing_to * pi / 180

  # The map is in longitude/latitude. Scale the longitude component by the
  # local latitude before drawing the true-north travel-direction arrow.
  arrow_y <- 0.13 * y_span
  arrow_x <- arrow_y * sin(angle) / cos(mean(c(ymin(e), ymax(e))) * pi / 180)
  arrow_dy <- arrow_y * cos(angle)
  arrow_x0 <- if (arrow_x >= 0) xmin(e) + 0.08 * x_span else xmax(e) - 0.08 * x_span
  arrow_y0 <- if (arrow_dy >= 0) ymin(e) + 0.10 * y_span else ymax(e) - 0.10 * y_span
  arrows(arrow_x0, arrow_y0, arrow_x0 + arrow_x, arrow_y0 + arrow_dy,
         col = "red", lwd = 3, length = 0.10)

  label <- c(
    paste("Local:", frame_local_time(elapsed_s)),
    sprintf("Model +%02.0f:%04.1f", floor(elapsed_s / 60), elapsed_s %% 60),
    sprintf("Buoy Hs %.2f m | Tp %.1f s", forcing$hs_m[1], forcing$tp_s[1]),
    sprintf("%s waves from %.0f° (arrow travels to %.0f°)",
            tools::toTitleCase(direction_statistic),
            forcing$boundary_direction_from_deg_true[1], bearing_to)
  )
  legend("topright", legend = label, bty = "o", bg = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.82),
         cex = 0.74, text.col = "black")
}

elevation_wgs84 <- project(elevation_raster, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
depth_file_wgs84 <- project(depth_from_file_rotated, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
depth_delta_wgs84 <- project(depth_file_minus_raster, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")

eta <- read_field("eta")

eta_paths <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^eta_[0-9]{5}$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
# FUNWAVE uses sequential output-file numbers in eta_00000, eta_00001, ...;
# they are not elapsed seconds. Convert those numbers using PLOT_INTV so the
# animation labels and the final-one-sixth selection use model time.
eta_file_number <- as.integer(sub("^eta_", "", basename(eta_paths)))
eta_order <- order(eta_file_number)
eta_paths <- eta_paths[eta_order]
eta_file_number <- eta_file_number[eta_order]
eta_time <- eta_file_number * grid$plot_intv_s
if (length(eta_paths) &&
    (any(!is.finite(eta_time)) || any(eta_time < 0) ||
     max(eta_time) > grid$total_time_s[1] + grid$plot_intv_s[1] ||
     max(eta_time) < grid$total_time_s[1] - grid$plot_intv_s[1])) {
  stop("eta file numbers do not map to the configured simulation period.")
}

# The previous report used depth.txt/MASK as a permanent land mask, which hid
# valid beach cells whenever their still-water depth was <= 0. Derive the
# visibility mask from the warped AHD DEM plus the greatest saved positive eta
# instead. This happens in model x/y before aggregation or reprojection, so a
# public map cannot invent a flooded cell through geographic interpolation.
eta_max_model <- NULL
if (length(eta_paths)) {
  for (path in eta_paths) {
    z <- read_text_model(path, basename(path))
    z[!is.finite(z)] <- NA_real_
    eta_max_model <- if (is.null(eta_max_model)) {
      z
    } else {
      pmax(eta_max_model, z, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  eta_max_model[!is.finite(eta_max_model)] <- NA_real_
}
applied_still_water_ahd_m <- if (
  "portland_water_level_ahd_m_applied" %in% names(forcing) &&
  is.finite(forcing$portland_water_level_ahd_m_applied[1])
) forcing$portland_water_level_ahd_m_applied[1] else 0
elevation_model <- rotated_raster_to_model_xy(elevation_raster)
max_water_depth_model <- pmax(0, applied_still_water_ahd_m - elevation_model)
if (!is.null(eta_max_model)) {
  max_water_depth_model <- applied_still_water_ahd_m - elevation_model +
    pmax(eta_max_model, 0)
  display_water_model <- is.finite(max_water_depth_model) & max_water_depth_model > 0
  display_water_mask_rotated <- model_to_rotated_raster(
    ifelse(display_water_model, 1, 0), "maximum-eta inundation mask"
  )
  display_water_mask_wgs84 <- project(display_water_mask_rotated, "EPSG:4326", method = "near")
  display_water_mask_label <- "maximum saved eta inundation extent"
}

read_public_output_raster <- function(path, label = basename(path)) {
  z <- read_text_model(path, basename(path))
  make_public_output_rotated(model_to_rotated_raster(z, label))
}
maximum_public_raster <- function(fields) {
  if (!length(fields)) return(NULL)
  out <- fields[[1]]
  if (length(fields) > 1) {
    for (k in 2:length(fields)) {
      out <- terra::app(c(out, fields[[k]]), fun = max, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  out
}

# Retain report fields only at the requested public resolution. The raw eta
# matrices above are streamed solely to establish the maximum-eta inundation
# mask; report fields themselves remain compact public-resolution rasters.
eta_public_frames <- lapply(eta_paths, read_public_output_raster)
eta_max <- maximum_public_raster(eta_public_frames)
if (!is.null(eta_max)) {
  eta_max[!is.finite(eta_max)] <- NA_real_
}

# FUNWAVE's WaveHeight=T diagnostic is written by PREVIEW_MEAN as Hsig files.
# It uses the model time step internally, so it is the correct way to assess
# wave energy rather than comparing individual 15-second eta snapshots.
hsig_paths <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^Hsig_[0-9]{5}$",
                         full.names = TRUE)
hsig_number <- as.integer(sub("^Hsig_", "", basename(hsig_paths)))
hsig_paths <- hsig_paths[order(hsig_number)]
hsig_public_frames <- lapply(hsig_paths, read_public_output_raster)
hsig_max <- maximum_public_raster(hsig_public_frames)
if (!is.null(hsig_max)) {
  hsig_max[!is.finite(hsig_max)] <- NA_real_
}

# `eta_max` and `hsig_max` above are already rotated public-resolution rasters,
# not model-index matrices. The original raw field files remain untouched.
eta_frames <- NULL
hsig_frames <- NULL

# Read the five FUNWAVE station files.  Each file is time, eta, u, v and the
# position metadata was created with stations.txt by the case setup script.
station_metadata_path <- file.path(case_dir, "station_metadata.csv")
station_metadata <- if (file.exists(station_metadata_path)) {
  read.csv(station_metadata_path, check.names = FALSE)
} else {
  data.frame()
}
station_timeseries <- data.frame()
if (nrow(station_metadata)) {
  station_series <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(station_metadata)), function(k) {
    path <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("sta_%04d", k))
    if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
    z <- utils::read.table(path, header = FALSE)
    if (ncol(z) < 2) return(NULL)
    names(z)[seq_len(min(4, ncol(z)))] <- c("time_s", "eta_m", "u_m_s", "v_m_s")[seq_len(min(4, ncol(z)))]
    z$station_id <- station_metadata$station_id[k]
    z
  })
  station_series <- Filter(Negate(is.null), station_series)
  if (length(station_series)) station_timeseries <- do.call(rbind, station_series)
}
if (nrow(station_timeseries)) {
  station_plot <- plotly::plot_ly()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(station_metadata))) {
    station_name <- station_metadata$station_id[k]
    z <- station_timeseries[station_timeseries$station_id == station_name, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(z)) {
      station_plot <- plotly::add_lines(
        station_plot, data = z, x = ~time_s, y = ~eta_m, name = station_name,
        line = list(color = station_colours[k], width = 2),
        hovertemplate = paste0(station_name, "<br>t = %{x:.1f} s<br>eta = %{y:.3f} m<extra></extra>")
      )
    }
  }
  station_plot <- plotly::layout(
    station_plot, title = "FUNWAVE eta along buoy-to-nearshore transect",
    xaxis = list(title = "Model elapsed time (s)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Free-surface elevation, eta (m)", range = eta_display_limits),
    legend = list(orientation = "h")
  )
  site_assets_dir <- file.path(report_site_dir, "assets")
  dir.create(site_assets_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
    station_plot, file.path(site_assets_dir, "port-fairy-transect-timeseries.html"),
    selfcontained = FALSE
  )
}

# Every run carries a small, explicit observed-condition context written by
# setup_port_fairy_funwave.R. Historical cases are centred on their requested
# time; the daily forecast shows the available seven days leading up to its
# selected forcing observation.
historical_wave_path <- file.path(case_dir, "historical_wave_observations.csv")
historical_portland_path <- file.path(case_dir, "historical_portland_water_levels.csv")
historical_window_metadata_path <- file.path(
  case_dir, "historical_observation_window_metadata.csv"
)
historical_observation_available <- all(file.exists(
  historical_wave_path, historical_portland_path, historical_window_metadata_path
))
historical_observation_page_url <- "assets/port-fairy-historical-observations.html"
historical_observation_page_path <- file.path(
  report_site_dir, historical_observation_page_url
)
historical_observation_page_status <- "Not a historical report."
historical_observation_summary <- data.frame(
  Diagnostic = "Historical observed-condition context", Value = "Not generated for the daily report.",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

parse_utc_timestamp <- function(x) {
  as.POSIXct(sub(" UTC$", "", as.character(x)),
             format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
}
add_requested_time_rule <- function(widget, requested_time, values) {
  finite_values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (!length(finite_values) || is.na(requested_time)) return(widget)
  limits <- range(finite_values)
  if (diff(limits) == 0) limits <- limits + c(-0.1, 0.1)
  plotly::add_segments(
    widget, x = requested_time, xend = requested_time,
    y = limits[1], yend = limits[2], inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE,
    line = list(color = "#d7301f", width = 1.5, dash = "dot"),
    hoverinfo = "skip"
  )
}

add_portland_mean_annual_maximum_rule <- function(widget, times, level_ahd_m) {
  valid_times <- times[!is.na(times)]
  if (!is.finite(level_ahd_m) || length(valid_times) < 2) return(widget)
  plotly::add_segments(
    widget,
    x = min(valid_times), xend = max(valid_times),
    y = level_ahd_m, yend = level_ahd_m,
    inherit = FALSE, name = "Portland mean annual maximum",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    line = list(color = "#d95f0e", width = 1.7, dash = "dash"),
    hovertemplate = paste0(
      "Portland mean annual maximum: ",
      formatC(level_ahd_m, format = "f", digits = 2),
      " m AHD<extra></extra>"
    )
  )
}

if (historical_observation_available) {
  historical_wave <- tryCatch(
    read.csv(historical_wave_path, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      historical_observation_page_status <<- paste0("Could not read historical wave observations: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
  historical_portland <- tryCatch(
    read.csv(historical_portland_path, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      historical_observation_page_status <<- paste0("Could not read historical Portland water levels: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
  historical_window_metadata <- tryCatch(
    read.csv(historical_window_metadata_path, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      historical_observation_page_status <<- paste0("Could not read historical observation metadata: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
  required_wave_columns <- c("time_utc", "hs_m", "tp_s", "direction_from_deg_true")
  required_tide_columns <- c("time_utc", "water_level_ahd_m")
  if (is.null(historical_wave) || is.null(historical_portland) ||
      is.null(historical_window_metadata) || nrow(historical_window_metadata) != 1 ||
      !all(required_wave_columns %in% names(historical_wave)) ||
      !all(required_tide_columns %in% names(historical_portland))) {
    historical_observation_available <- FALSE
    if (identical(historical_observation_page_status, "Not a historical report.")) {
      historical_observation_page_status <- "Historical observed-condition files have an unexpected structure."
    }
  } else {
    historical_wave$time_utc <- parse_utc_timestamp(historical_wave$time_utc)
    historical_portland$time_utc <- parse_utc_timestamp(historical_portland$time_utc)
    observation_context_mode <- if ("observation_mode" %in% names(historical_window_metadata)) {
      as.character(historical_window_metadata$observation_mode[1])
    } else {
      "historical"
    }
    observation_is_historical <- identical(observation_context_mode, "historical")
    observation_context_label <- if (observation_is_historical) "historical run" else "forecast"
    historical_wave$hover_local <- format(
      historical_wave$time_utc, tz = port_fairy_tz, format = "%d %b %Y %H:%M %Z"
    )
    historical_portland$hover_local <- format(
      historical_portland$time_utc, tz = port_fairy_tz, format = "%d %b %Y %H:%M %Z"
    )
    requested_historical_time <- parse_utc_timestamp(
      historical_window_metadata$requested_time_utc[1]
    )
    selected_historical_time <- parse_utc_timestamp(
      historical_window_metadata$selected_buoy_time_utc[1]
    )
    window_label <- paste0(
      format(parse_utc_timestamp(historical_window_metadata$window_start_utc[1]),
             tz = port_fairy_tz, format = "%d %b %Y %H:%M %Z"),
      " to ",
      format(parse_utc_timestamp(historical_window_metadata$window_end_utc[1]),
             tz = port_fairy_tz, format = "%d %b %Y %H:%M %Z")
    )
    portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m <- if (
      "portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m" %in% names(forcing)
    ) as.numeric(forcing$portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m[1]) else NA_real_
    portland_mean_annual_maximum_years <- if (
      "portland_mean_annual_maximum_years" %in% names(forcing)
    ) as.integer(forcing$portland_mean_annual_maximum_years[1]) else NA_integer_
    local_time_axis <- list(
      title = "Port Fairy local time",
      type = "date",
      tickformat = "%d %b<br>%H:%M",
      hoverformat = "%d %b %Y %H:%M"
    )

    p_hs <- plotly::plot_ly(
      historical_wave, x = ~time_utc, y = ~hs_m, text = ~hover_local,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = ygnbu_palette[9], width = 2),
      marker = list(color = ygnbu_palette[9], size = 4),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Hs: %{y:.2f} m<extra></extra>",
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    p_hs <- add_requested_time_rule(p_hs, requested_historical_time,
                                    c(0, historical_wave$hs_m))
    p_hs <- plotly::add_markers(
      p_hs, data = data.frame(time_utc = selected_historical_time,
                              value = forcing$hs_m[1]),
      x = ~time_utc, y = ~value, inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE,
      marker = list(color = "#d7301f", size = 9, symbol = "diamond"),
      hovertemplate = "FUNWAVE forcing record<br>Hs: %{y:.2f} m<extra></extra>"
    )
    p_hs <- plotly::layout(
      p_hs, xaxis = local_time_axis,
      yaxis = list(title = "Hs (m)", range = c(0, 6))
    )

    p_tp <- plotly::plot_ly(
      historical_wave, x = ~time_utc, y = ~tp_s, text = ~hover_local,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = ygnbu_palette[7], width = 2),
      marker = list(color = ygnbu_palette[7], size = 4),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Tp: %{y:.2f} s<extra></extra>",
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    p_tp <- add_requested_time_rule(p_tp, requested_historical_time, historical_wave$tp_s)
    p_tp <- plotly::add_markers(
      p_tp, data = data.frame(time_utc = selected_historical_time,
                              value = forcing$tp_s[1]),
      x = ~time_utc, y = ~value, inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE,
      marker = list(color = "#d7301f", size = 9, symbol = "diamond"),
      hovertemplate = "FUNWAVE forcing record<br>Tp: %{y:.2f} s<extra></extra>"
    )
    p_tp <- plotly::layout(
      p_tp, xaxis = local_time_axis,
      yaxis = list(title = "Tp (s)", rangemode = "tozero")
    )

    p_direction <- plotly::plot_ly(
      historical_wave, x = ~time_utc, y = ~direction_from_deg_true,
      text = ~hover_local, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
      marker = list(color = ygnbu_palette[5], size = 5),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Wave direction from: %{y:.0f}°<extra></extra>",
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    p_direction <- add_requested_time_rule(
      p_direction, requested_historical_time, c(0, 360)
    )
    p_direction <- plotly::add_markers(
      p_direction, data = data.frame(time_utc = selected_historical_time,
                                     value = forcing$boundary_direction_from_deg_true[1]),
      x = ~time_utc, y = ~value, inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE,
      marker = list(color = "#d7301f", size = 9, symbol = "diamond"),
      hovertemplate = "FUNWAVE forcing record<br>Direction from: %{y:.0f}°<extra></extra>"
    )
    p_direction <- plotly::layout(
      p_direction, xaxis = local_time_axis,
      yaxis = list(title = "Direction from (°)", range = c(0, 360), dtick = 90)
    )

    p_tide <- plotly::plot_ly(
      historical_portland, x = ~time_utc, y = ~water_level_ahd_m,
      text = ~hover_local, type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
      line = list(color = ygnbu_palette[3], width = 2),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Portland water level: %{y:.2f} m AHD<extra></extra>",
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    p_tide <- add_requested_time_rule(
      p_tide, requested_historical_time, historical_portland$water_level_ahd_m
    )
    p_tide <- add_portland_mean_annual_maximum_rule(
      p_tide, historical_portland$time_utc, portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m
    )
    applied_portland_time <- parse_utc_timestamp(forcing$portland_water_level_time_utc[1])
    if (is.finite(forcing$portland_water_level_ahd_m_applied[1]) &&
        !is.na(applied_portland_time)) {
      p_tide <- plotly::add_markers(
        p_tide,
        data = data.frame(
          time_utc = applied_portland_time,
          value = forcing$portland_water_level_ahd_m_applied[1]
        ),
        x = ~time_utc, y = ~value, inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE,
        marker = list(color = "#d7301f", size = 9, symbol = "diamond"),
        hovertemplate = "FUNWAVE applied level<br>Portland: %{y:.2f} m AHD<extra></extra>"
      )
    }
    p_tide <- plotly::layout(
      p_tide, xaxis = local_time_axis,
      yaxis = list(title = "Portland level (m AHD)")
    )

    historical_observation_plot <- plotly::subplot(
      p_hs, p_tp, p_direction, p_tide,
      nrows = 4, shareX = FALSE, titleY = TRUE, margin = 0.045,
      heights = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
    )
    historical_observation_plot <- plotly::layout(
      historical_observation_plot,
      title = paste0("Observed Port Fairy waves and Portland water level: ", window_label),
      xaxis = local_time_axis,
      xaxis2 = local_time_axis,
      xaxis3 = local_time_axis,
      xaxis4 = local_time_axis,
      hovermode = "x unified",
      annotations = list(list(
        text = paste0(
          "Red dotted line: requested model time. Red diamond: observation applied to FUNWAVE.",
          if (is.finite(portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m)) {
            paste0(
              " Orange dashed line: Portland mean annual maximum ",
              formatC(portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m, format = "f", digits = 2),
              " m AHD (", portland_mean_annual_maximum_years, " sufficiently complete local years)."
            )
          } else {
            ""
          }
        ),
        x = 0, y = -0.08, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "left", font = list(size = 11)
      ))
    )
    historical_observation_plot <- plotly::config(
      historical_observation_plot, displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE
    )
    dir.create(dirname(historical_observation_page_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    historical_observation_page_status <- tryCatch({
      htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
        historical_observation_plot, historical_observation_page_path, selfcontained = FALSE
      )
      if (!file.exists(historical_observation_page_path) ||
          file.info(historical_observation_page_path)$size < 1000) {
        stop("The historical observed-condition page was not written.")
      }
      "Published interactive Hs, Tp, direction and Portland water-level plots."
    }, error = function(e) {
      paste0("Could not write historical observed-condition page: ", conditionMessage(e))
    })
    historical_observation_summary <- data.frame(
      Diagnostic = c("Requested historical time", "FUNWAVE buoy forcing record",
                     "Window", "QC 1/2 wave observations", "Portland observations",
                     "Water-level datum", "Portland mean annual maximum",
                     "Complete local years used", "Observed-condition page"),
      Value = c(
        format(requested_historical_time, tz = port_fairy_tz, usetz = TRUE),
        format(selected_historical_time, tz = port_fairy_tz, usetz = TRUE),
        window_label,
        historical_window_metadata$wave_records_qc_1_or_2[1],
        historical_window_metadata$portland_records[1],
        historical_window_metadata$portland_datum[1],
        ifelse(is.finite(portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m),
               paste0(formatC(portland_mean_annual_maximum_ahd_m, format = "f", digits = 2), " m AHD"),
               "not available"),
        ifelse(is.finite(portland_mean_annual_maximum_years),
               portland_mean_annual_maximum_years, "not available"),
        historical_observation_page_status
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# The retained particle pages use FUNWAVE's time-mean Umean/Vmean fields, not
# phase-resolved U/V snapshots. That avoids using wave-orbital velocities as
# currents: the latter reverse each wave period and make particles wobble.
site_assets_dir <- file.path(report_site_dir, "assets")
dir.create(site_assets_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
current_particle_page_path <- file.path(site_assets_dir, "port-fairy-flow-particles.html")
current_particle_page_url <- "assets/port-fairy-flow-particles.html"
current_particle_page_status <- "No paired Umean/Vmean output was produced."
u_paths <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^Umean_[0-9]{5}$",
                      ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
v_paths <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^Vmean_[0-9]{5}$",
                      ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
current_file_number <- function(paths) {
  as.integer(sub("^[[:alpha:]]+_", "", basename(paths)))
}
u_numbers <- current_file_number(u_paths)
v_numbers <- current_file_number(v_paths)
common_current_numbers <- sort(intersect(u_numbers, v_numbers))
current_numbers <- integer()
if (length(common_current_numbers)) {
  # A Umean/Vmean number labels the mean-output record, not elapsed seconds.
  # Use the newest paired record as the stable current field.
  current_numbers <- tail(common_current_numbers, 1)
}
current_label <- "No paired Umean/Vmean output was produced"
current_time_label <- "n/a"
current_peak_speed <- NA_real_
current_speed_floor <- NA_real_
current_seed_count <- 0L
current_streamline_count <- 0L
current_public_cell_count <- 0L
current_public_grid_shape <- "n/a"
current_selected_files <- "none"
current_candidate_count <- 0L
current_source_exclusion_m <- max(200, 20 * max(grid$dx_m[1], grid$dy_m[1]))
# Smooth the vector components, never the angle. A 10 m Gaussian standard
# deviation (about 24 m full-width at half-maximum) suppresses most
# crest/trough residuals while retaining finer along-beach circulation.
current_smoothing_sigma_m <- 10
current_smoothing_label <- paste0(
  "masked Gaussian component smoothing: sigma ",
  metres_label(current_smoothing_sigma_m), " m (FWHM ",
  metres_label(2.355 * current_smoothing_sigma_m), " m)"
)

# Umean/Vmean close to an internal wavemaker are dominated by the numerical
# source zone rather than by an interpretable nearshore circulation pattern.
# Keep the source visible as a reference line, but exclude a 200 m (minimum)
# shoreward buffer from all current-path seeding and particle display fields.
current_display_mask_model <- outer(
  (seq_len(grid$Mglob[1]) - 1) * grid$dx_m[1], seq_len(grid$Nglob[1]),
  function(x, y) x >= grid$x_wk_m[1] + current_source_exclusion_m
)
current_display_mask_rotated <- model_to_rotated_raster(
  ifelse(current_display_mask_model, 1, NA_real_), "current-display mask"
)
apply_current_display_mask_model <- function(z) {
  z <- apply_output_visibility_mask_model(z)
  z[!current_display_mask_model] <- NA_real_
  z
}
apply_current_display_mask_rotated <- function(r_om) {
  # Callers have already run make_public_output_rotated(), which applies the
  # maximum-eta and wavemaker masks at the field's own resolution. Do not
  # apply native masks again here, because terra rejects mismatched geometry.
  display_mask <- current_display_mask_rotated
  if (!compareGeom(display_mask, r_om, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    display_mask <- resample(display_mask, r_om, method = "near")
  }
  r_om[is.na(display_mask) | display_mask <= 0] <- NA_real_
  r_om
}

smooth_mean_current_components <- function(u, v, sigma_m = current_smoothing_sigma_m) {
  # Work in native FUNWAVE x/y before any aggregation or geographic projection.
  # Invalid land/source cells carry zero numerator *and* zero weight, so this
  # normalized filter cannot import values across the existing water mask.
  valid <- is.finite(u) & is.finite(v)
  if (!any(valid) || !is.finite(sigma_m) || sigma_m <= 0) {
    u[!valid] <- NA_real_
    v[!valid] <- NA_real_
    return(list(u = u, v = v))
  }

  radius_x <- max(1L, ceiling(3 * sigma_m / grid$dx_m[1]))
  radius_y <- max(1L, ceiling(3 * sigma_m / grid$dy_m[1]))
  x_m <- seq.int(-radius_x, radius_x) * grid$dx_m[1]
  y_m <- seq.int(-radius_y, radius_y) * grid$dy_m[1]
  weights <- outer(x_m, y_m, function(x, y) {
    exp(-0.5 * ((x / sigma_m)^2 + (y / sigma_m)^2))
  })
  weights <- weights / sum(weights)

  matrix_raster <- function(z) {
    r <- rast(nrows = nrow(z), ncols = ncol(z),
              xmin = 0, xmax = nrow(z), ymin = 0, ymax = ncol(z))
    values(r) <- as.numeric(t(z))
    r
  }
  raster_matrix <- function(r, n_x, n_y) {
    matrix(values(r), nrow = n_x, ncol = n_y, byrow = TRUE)
  }
  focal_normalized <- function(z) {
    z[!valid] <- 0
    numerator <- focal(matrix_raster(z), w = weights, fun = "sum", fillvalue = 0)
    denominator <- focal(matrix_raster(ifelse(valid, 1, 0)), w = weights,
                         fun = "sum", fillvalue = 0)
    out <- raster_matrix(numerator, nrow(z), ncol(z)) /
      raster_matrix(denominator, nrow(z), ncol(z))
    out[!valid] <- NA_real_
    out
  }
  list(u = focal_normalized(u), v = focal_normalized(v))
}

model_xy_to_wgs84 <- function(xy_model) {
  xy_om <- if (source_is_low_x) {
    cbind(xmin(depth_raster) + xy_model[, 1], ymin(depth_raster) + xy_model[, 2])
  } else {
    cbind(xmax(depth_raster) - xy_model[, 1], ymax(depth_raster) - xy_model[, 2])
  }
  crds(project(vect(xy_om, type = "points", crs = crs(depth_raster)), "EPSG:4326"))
}

trace_current_streamline <- function(seed_xy, u_flow, v_flow, speed_floor,
                                     source_exclusion_m, step_m = 5,
                                     n_steps = 520) {
  # Bilinear midpoint integration avoids the jagged nearest-grid-cell paths
  # that occurred when a particle crossed a 5 m cell boundary.
  velocity_at <- function(xy) {
    g <- xy / c(grid$dx_m[1], grid$dy_m[1]) + 1
    i <- floor(g[1]); j <- floor(g[2])
    if (i < 1 || j < 1 || i >= nrow(u_flow) || j >= ncol(u_flow)) return(NULL)
    fx <- g[1] - i; fy <- g[2] - j
    u_values <- c(u_flow[i, j], u_flow[i + 1, j],
                  u_flow[i, j + 1], u_flow[i + 1, j + 1])
    v_values <- c(v_flow[i, j], v_flow[i + 1, j],
                  v_flow[i, j + 1], v_flow[i + 1, j + 1])
    if (any(!is.finite(u_values)) || any(!is.finite(v_values))) return(NULL)
    weights <- c((1 - fx) * (1 - fy), fx * (1 - fy),
                 (1 - fx) * fy, fx * fy)
    c(u = sum(weights * u_values), v = sum(weights * v_values))
  }
  inside <- function(xy) {
    xy[1] >= grid$x_wk_m[1] + source_exclusion_m &&
      xy[1] <= (nrow(u_flow) - 1) * grid$dx_m[1] &&
      xy[2] >= 0 && xy[2] <= (ncol(u_flow) - 1) * grid$dy_m[1]
  }
  advance <- function(direction) {
    xy <- seed_xy
    out <- matrix(xy, ncol = 2)
    for (step in seq_len(n_steps)) {
      v0 <- velocity_at(xy)
      speed0 <- if (is.null(v0)) NA_real_ else sqrt(sum(v0^2))
      if (!is.finite(speed0) || speed0 < speed_floor) break
      midpoint <- xy + direction * 0.5 * step_m * v0 / speed0
      vmid <- velocity_at(midpoint)
      speed_mid <- if (is.null(vmid)) NA_real_ else sqrt(sum(vmid^2))
      if (!is.finite(speed_mid) || speed_mid < speed_floor) break
      candidate <- xy + direction * step_m * vmid / speed_mid
      if (!inside(candidate)) break
      xy <- candidate
      out <- rbind(out, xy)
    }
    out
  }
  backward <- advance(-1)
  forward <- advance(1)
  rbind(backward[nrow(backward):1, , drop = FALSE], forward[-1, , drop = FALSE])
}

if (length(current_numbers)) {
  read_current_component <- function(paths, numbers) {
    path_numbers <- current_file_number(paths)
    fields <- lapply(numbers, function(number) {
      path <- paths[match(number, path_numbers)]
      apply_current_display_mask_model(read_text_model(path, basename(path)))
    })
    total <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(fields[[1]]), ncol = ncol(fields[[1]]))
    count <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(fields[[1]]), ncol = ncol(fields[[1]]))
    for (field in fields) {
      keep <- is.finite(field)
      total[keep] <- total[keep] + field[keep]
      count[keep] <- count[keep] + 1
    }
    total[count == 0] <- NA_real_
    total[count > 0] <- total[count > 0] / count[count > 0]
    total
  }

  current_selected_files <- paste(sprintf("%05d", current_numbers), collapse = ", ")
  u_flow <- read_current_component(u_paths, current_numbers)
  v_flow <- read_current_component(v_paths, current_numbers)
  current_smoothed <- smooth_mean_current_components(u_flow, v_flow)
  u_flow <- current_smoothed$u
  v_flow <- current_smoothed$v
  current_speed <- sqrt(u_flow^2 + v_flow^2)
  current_label <- paste0("Time-mean depth-averaged current: latest Umean/Vmean output; ",
                          current_smoothing_label)
  current_time_label <- paste0(metres_label(grid$mean_wave_interval_s[1]),
                               " s FUNWAVE averaging interval; ",
                               current_smoothing_label)
  valid_speed <- current_speed[is.finite(current_speed) & current_speed > 0]
  # The old 5 mm/s floor accepted only the rapid source-zone flow.  Use a
  # small data-derived threshold so valid weak circulation can seed paths.
  speed_floor <- if (length(valid_speed)) {
    max(0.0005, 0.10 * as.numeric(stats::quantile(valid_speed, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)))
  } else {
    Inf
  }
  current_peak_speed <- if (length(valid_speed)) max(valid_speed) else NA_real_
  current_speed_floor <- speed_floor

  x_margin <- max(4 * grid$dx_m[1], 50)
  y_margin <- max(4 * grid$dy_m[1], 100)
  x_start <- grid$x_wk_m[1] + current_source_exclusion_m + x_margin
  x_end <- (nrow(u_flow) - 1) * grid$dx_m[1] - x_margin
  y_start <- y_margin
  y_end <- (ncol(u_flow) - 1) * grid$dy_m[1] - y_margin
  seeds <- if (x_start < x_end && y_start < y_end && is.finite(speed_floor)) {
    as.matrix(expand.grid(
      seq(x_start, x_end, length.out = 37),
      seq(y_start, y_end, length.out = 27)
    ))
  } else {
    matrix(numeric(), ncol = 2)
  }
  trace_seed_set <- function(seed_set, threshold) {
    candidates <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(seed_set)), function(k) {
      ij <- pmax(c(1, 1), pmin(c(nrow(u_flow), ncol(u_flow)),
                               round(seed_set[k, ] / c(grid$dx_m[1], grid$dy_m[1])) + 1L))
      if (!is.finite(current_speed[ij[1], ij[2]]) || current_speed[ij[1], ij[2]] < threshold) return(NULL)
      path <- trace_current_streamline(
        seed_set[k, ], u_flow, v_flow, threshold,
        source_exclusion_m = current_source_exclusion_m,
        step_m = max(2.5, min(7.5, min(grid$dx_m[1], grid$dy_m[1]))),
        n_steps = 520
      )
      if (nrow(path) < 20) return(NULL)
      list(seed = as.numeric(seed_set[k, ]), path = path)
    })
    Filter(Negate(is.null), candidates)
  }
  select_spread_streamlines <- function(candidates, max_paths = 288L,
                                        min_separation_m = 70) {
    if (!length(candidates)) return(list())
    path_lengths <- vapply(candidates, function(z) nrow(z$path), integer(1))
    remaining <- seq_along(candidates)
    first <- remaining[which.max(path_lengths[remaining])]
    chosen_indices <- first
    chosen_seeds <- matrix(candidates[[first]]$seed, nrow = 1)
    remaining <- setdiff(remaining, first)
    while (length(chosen_indices) < max_paths && length(remaining)) {
      nearest_distance <- vapply(remaining, function(candidate_index) {
        candidate <- candidates[[candidate_index]]
        min(sqrt(rowSums((chosen_seeds - matrix(
          candidate$seed, nrow = nrow(chosen_seeds), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE
        ))^2)))
      }, numeric(1))
      eligible <- which(nearest_distance >= min_separation_m)
      if (!length(eligible)) break
      farthest <- max(nearest_distance[eligible])
      ties <- eligible[abs(nearest_distance[eligible] - farthest) < 1e-8]
      winner_position <- ties[which.max(path_lengths[remaining[ties]])]
      winner <- remaining[winner_position]
      chosen_indices <- c(chosen_indices, winner)
      chosen_seeds <- rbind(chosen_seeds, candidates[[winner]]$seed)
      remaining <- remaining[-winner_position]
    }
    candidates[chosen_indices]
  }
  current_seed_count <- nrow(seeds)
  streamline_candidates <- trace_seed_set(seeds, speed_floor)
  current_candidate_count <- length(streamline_candidates)
  selected_streamlines <- select_spread_streamlines(streamline_candidates)
  # Do not silently publish a blank animation because the initially selected
  # percentile threshold was too strict. This lower threshold remains based on
  # real FUNWAVE Umean/Vmean output; it merely allows slow, valid current paths to be
  # shown and records the fallback in the diagnostics.
  if (!length(selected_streamlines) && length(valid_speed)) {
    fallback_floor <- max(0.0001, 0.01 * as.numeric(stats::quantile(
      valid_speed, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE
    )))
    if (is.finite(fallback_floor) && fallback_floor < speed_floor) {
      speed_floor <- fallback_floor
      current_speed_floor <- speed_floor
      streamline_candidates <- trace_seed_set(seeds, speed_floor)
      current_candidate_count <- length(streamline_candidates)
      selected_streamlines <- select_spread_streamlines(streamline_candidates)
      if (length(selected_streamlines)) {
        current_label <- paste0(current_label, " (low-speed path fallback)")
      }
    }
  }
  streamlines_model <- lapply(selected_streamlines, function(z) z$path)
  streamlines_ll <- lapply(streamlines_model, model_xy_to_wgs84)
  streamlines_ll <- Filter(function(z) {
    is.matrix(z) && nrow(z) >= 4 && all(is.finite(z))
  }, streamlines_ll)
  current_streamline_count <- length(streamlines_ll)

  west <- min(model_outline_ll_xy[, 1]); east <- max(model_outline_ll_xy[, 1])
  south <- min(model_outline_ll_xy[, 2]); north <- max(model_outline_ll_xy[, 2])
  x_pad <- (east - west) * 0.04; y_pad <- (north - south) * 0.04
  current_bounds <- list(c(south - y_pad, west - x_pad), c(north + y_pad, east + x_pad))
  x_max_pad <- (east - west) * 0.50; y_max_pad <- (north - south) * 0.50
  current_max_bounds <- list(c(south - y_max_pad, west - x_max_pad),
                             c(north + y_max_pad, east + x_max_pad))
  outline_latlng <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(model_outline_ll_xy)), function(k) {
    unname(as.numeric(model_outline_ll_xy[k, c(2, 1)]))
  })
  source_latlng <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(source_line_ll_xy)), function(k) {
    unname(as.numeric(source_line_ll_xy[k, c(2, 1)]))
  })
  buoy_latlng <- unname(as.numeric(c(crds(buoy_ll)[1, 2], crds(buoy_ll)[1, 1])))
  debug_prefix <- paste(
    "Paired Umean/Vmean files:", length(common_current_numbers),
    "Selected file number(s):", current_selected_files,
    "Field:", current_label,
    "Output window:", current_time_label,
    "Peak speed (m/s):", ifelse(is.finite(current_peak_speed), format(round(current_peak_speed, 3), nsmall = 3), "n/a"),
    "Trace floor (m/s):", ifelse(is.finite(current_speed_floor), format(round(current_speed_floor, 3), nsmall = 3), "n/a"),
    "Wavemaker exclusion (m):", format(round(current_source_exclusion_m, 1), trim = TRUE),
    "Candidate paths:", current_candidate_count,
    sep = "\n"
  )

  # The particle paths are traced through time-mean Umean/Vmean on the native
  # rotated grid using bilinear, midpoint integration. They are then projected
  # to WGS84 as paths, retaining geographic direction without cell-to-cell
  # stair-stepping.
  particle_routes <- lapply(streamlines_ll, function(z) {
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(z)), function(k) unname(as.numeric(z[k, c(2, 1)])))
  })
  current_public_cell_count <- sum(vapply(particle_routes, length, integer(1)))
  current_public_grid_shape <- paste0(metres_label(grid$dx_m[1]), "m x ",
                                      metres_label(grid$dy_m[1]), "m native paths")
  option2_data <- list(
    bounds = current_bounds,
    max_bounds = current_max_bounds,
    outline = outline_latlng,
    source = source_latlng,
    buoy = buoy_latlng,
    routes = particle_routes,
    label = paste(current_label, paste0("Output window: ", current_time_label),
                  "Particle trails follow smoothly integrated Umean/Vmean paths on the native rotated grid.",
                  "Animation speed is visual only; direction is the simulated flow direction.",
                  sep = "\n"),
    debug = paste(debug_prefix, "Native current path grid:", current_public_grid_shape,
                  "Animated paths:", length(particle_routes),
                  "Path vertices:", current_public_cell_count,
                  sep = "\n"),
    routeCount = length(particle_routes)
  )
  option2_js <- paste0(
    "function(el, x, data) {",
    "var map=this;if(!map||typeof map.getPanes!=='function')map=this.map||this._map;",
    "if(!map||typeof map.getPanes!=='function'){console.error('Leaflet map was not available for flow particles');return;}",
    "document.documentElement.style.height='100%';document.body.style.margin='0';document.body.style.height='100%';el.style.width='100vw';el.style.height='100vh';",
    "var routes=data.routes||[],bounds=L.latLngBounds(data.bounds),maxBounds=L.latLngBounds(data.max_bounds||data.bounds),particles=[];",
    "function distanceM(a,b){var r=6371000,dlat=(b[0]-a[0])*Math.PI/180,dlon=(b[1]-a[1])*Math.PI/180,lat=(a[0]+b[0])*Math.PI/360;return r*Math.sqrt(dlat*dlat+Math.cos(lat)*Math.cos(lat)*dlon*dlon);}",
    "function prepareRoute(points){if(!points||points.length<4)return null;var cumulative=[0];for(var i=1;i<points.length;i++)cumulative.push(cumulative[i-1]+distanceM(points[i-1],points[i]));var length=cumulative[cumulative.length-1];return length>40?{points:points,cumulative:cumulative,length:length}:null;}",
    "function pointAt(route,metres){if(!route||metres<0||metres>route.length)return null;var i=0;while(i<route.cumulative.length-2&&route.cumulative[i+1]<metres)i++;var a=route.points[i],b=route.points[i+1],span=route.cumulative[i+1]-route.cumulative[i],f=span>0?(metres-route.cumulative[i])/span:0;return [a[0]+f*(b[0]-a[0]),a[1]+f*(b[1]-a[1])];}",
    "routes.map(prepareRoute).filter(function(route){return route!==null;}).forEach(function(route,i){for(var j=0;j<4;j++)particles.push({route:route,distance:(i*47+j*route.length/4)%route.length});});",
    "var FlowTrails=L.Layer.extend({initialize:function(){this._running=false;},onAdd:function(m){this._map=m;this._canvas=L.DomUtil.create('canvas','leaflet-zoom-animated',m.getPanes().overlayPane);this._canvas.style.pointerEvents='none';this._canvas.style.zIndex=650;this._resize();m.on('resize moveend zoomend',this._resize,this);this._running=true;this._last=performance.now();this._frame=window.requestAnimationFrame(this._animate.bind(this));},onRemove:function(m){this._running=false;window.cancelAnimationFrame(this._frame);m.off('resize s=this._map.getSize(),d=window.devicePixelRatio||1;this._canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(s.x*d));this._canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(s.y*d));this._canvas.style.width=s.x+'px';this._canvas.style.height=s.y+'px';this._topLeft=this._map.containerPointToLayerPoint([0,0]);L.DomUtil.setPosition(this._canvas,this._topLeft);this._ctx=this._canvas.getContext('2d');this._ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);},_animate:function(t){if(!this._running)return;var
```
