ctx.lineTo(px,py);},this);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(8,48,107,0.78)';ctx.lineWidth=1.45;ctx.stroke();var head=trail[trail.length-1],hp=map.latLngToLayerPoint(head);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(44,127,184,0.98)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(hp.x-this._topLeft.x,hp.y-this._topLeft.y,2.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();},this);this._frame=window.requestAnimationFrame(this._animate.bind(this));}});",
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
    "var flowTrails=new FlowTrails();flowTrails.addTo(map);",
    "L.control.layers({}, {'Flowing particle trails':flowTrails},{collapsed:false}).addTo(map);",
    "function panel(position,text){var c=L.control({position:position});c.onAdd=function(){var d=L.DomUtil.create('div');d.style.background='rgba(255,255,255,.92)';d.style.padding='6px 8px';d.style.font='12px/1.3 Arial';d.style.whiteSpace='pre-line';d.style.width='min(240px,calc(100vw - 44px))';d.style.maxWidth='240px';d.style.maxHeight='min(135px,calc(100vh - 150px))';d.style.overflow='auto';d.style.boxSizing='border-box';d.style.marginBottom='24px';d.textContent=text;return d;};c.addTo(map);}",
    "function addFullscreen(){var c=L.control({position:'topleft'});c.onAdd=function(){var b=L.DomUtil.create('button');b.type='button';b.title='Toggle full screen';b.textContent='⛶';b.style.cssText='width:30px;height:30px;background:#fff;border:0;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer';L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(b);L.DomEvent.on(b,'click',function(){if(!document.fullscreenElement&&el.requestFullscreen){el.requestFullscreen();}else if(document.exitFullscreen){document.exitFullscreen();}});return b;};c.addTo(map);document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',function(){window.setTimeout(function(){map.invalidateSize();},80);});}addFullscreen();",
    "panel('bottomleft',data.label);panel('bottomright',data.debug);",
    "window.setTimeout(function(){map.invalidateSize();map.fitBounds(bounds,{padding:[4,4]});map.setMaxBounds(maxBounds);},250);",
    "}"
  )
  option2_widget <- leaflet::leaflet(
    width = "100vw", height = "100vh",
    options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom = 12, maxZoom = 18, maxBoundsViscosity = 1)
  )
  option2_widget <- leaflet::addProviderTiles(option2_widget, "OpenStreetMap.Mapnik", group = "OpenStreetMap")
  option2_widget <- leaflet::addProviderTiles(option2_widget, "Esri.WorldImagery", group = "Satellite imagery")
  option2_widget <- leaflet::setMaxBounds(option2_widget,
                                           current_max_bounds[[1]][2], current_max_bounds[[1]][1],
                                           current_max_bounds[[2]][2], current_max_bounds[[2]][1])
  option2_widget <- leaflet::fitBounds(option2_widget,
                                       current_bounds[[1]][2], current_bounds[[1]][1],
                                       current_bounds[[2]][2], current_bounds[[2]][1])
  option2_widget <- leaflet::addPolylines(option2_widget,
                                           lng = model_outline_ll_xy[, 1], lat = model_outline_ll_xy[, 2],
                                           color = "black", weight = 2, group = "FUNWAVE grid")
  option2_widget <- leaflet::addPolylines(option2_widget,
                                           lng = source_line_ll_xy[, 1], lat = source_line_ll_xy[, 2],
                                           color = "dodgerblue3", weight = 2, dashArray = "6 6",
                                           group = "Internal wavemaker")
  option2_widget <- leaflet::addCircleMarkers(option2_widget,
                                               lng = crds(buoy_ll)[1, 1], lat = crds(buoy_ll)[1, 2],
                                               radius = 5, color = "red", fillOpacity = 1, group = "Buoy")
  for (route in streamlines_ll) {
    option2_widget <- leaflet::addPolylines(option2_widget,
                                             lng = route[, 1], lat = route[, 2],
                                             color = "#2c7fb8", weight = 1, opacity = 0.28,
                                             group = "Mean-flow paths")
  }
  option2_widget <- leaflet::addLayersControl(
    option2_widget,
    baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap", "Satellite imagery"),
    overlayGroups = c("Mean-flow paths", "FUNWAVE grid", "Internal wavemaker", "Buoy"),
    options = leaflet::layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
  option2_widget <- leaflet::hideGroup(option2_widget, "OpenStreetMap")
  option2_widget <- leaflet::showGroup(option2_widget, "Satellite imagery")
  option2_widget <- htmlwidgets::onRender(option2_widget, option2_js, data = option2_data)
  current_particle_page_status <- tryCatch({
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(option2_widget, current_particle_page_path, selfcontained = TRUE)
    if (!file.exists(current_particle_page_path) || file.info(current_particle_page_path)$size < 5000) {
      stop("The particle page was not written or is unexpectedly small.")
    }
    paste0("Published with ", length(particle_routes), " animated current paths.")
  }, error = function(e) {
    paste0("Particle page write failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}

if (!file.exists(current_particle_page_path)) {
  fallback_text <- paste(
    "The flow-particle page could not be animated for this run.",
    paste0("Umean files found: ", length(u_paths)),
    paste0("Vmean files found: ", length(v_paths)),
    paste0("Paired fields: ", length(common_current_numbers)),
    paste0("Status: ", current_particle_page_status),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  fallback_saved <- tryCatch({
    htmltools::save_html(
      htmltools::tags$html(
        htmltools::tags$head(htmltools::tags$title("Port Fairy current-flow diagnostics")),
        htmltools::tags$body(
          style = "font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 58rem; margin: 3rem auto; line-height: 1.45;",
          htmltools::tags$h1("Port Fairy current-flow diagnostics"),
          htmltools::tags$p("No animated paths were available for this model run."),
          htmltools::tags$pre(fallback_text)
        )
      ),
      file = current_particle_page_path
    )
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    current_particle_page_status <<- paste0(current_particle_page_status,
                                             " Fallback page write failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    FALSE
  })
  if (fallback_saved) {
    current_particle_page_status <- paste0(current_particle_page_status,
                                           " A diagnostic page was published instead.")
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Additional Earth-style, time-mean current animation
#
# This is deliberately additional to the retained native-grid particle page
# above. It uses a display-field interpolation and a particle
# ageing/trail renderer rather than pre-traced routes, while still sourcing
# the same FUNWAVE Umean/Vmean outputs over T_INTV_mean.
#
# The browser animator below adapts the particle ageing, vector interpolation,
# destination-in trail fade, and per-frame evolve/draw approach in earth.js
# from https://github.com/cambecc/earth (MIT License).
# Copyright (c) 2014 Cameron Beccario.  The complete MIT notice is embedded
# in the generated page data so it accompanies the adapted implementation.
earth_flow_page_path <- file.path(site_assets_dir, "port-fairy-earth-nullschool-flow.html")
earth_flow_page_url <- "assets/port-fairy-earth-nullschool-flow.html"
earth_flow_page_status <- "No paired Umean/Vmean output was produced."
earth_u_paths <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^Umean_[0-9]{5}$",
                            ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
earth_v_paths <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^Vmean_[0-9]{5}$",
                            ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
earth_file_number <- function(paths) {
  as.integer(sub("^[[:alpha:]]+_", "", basename(paths)))
}
earth_u_numbers <- earth_file_number(earth_u_paths)
earth_v_numbers <- earth_file_number(earth_v_paths)
earth_common_numbers <- sort(intersect(earth_u_numbers, earth_v_numbers))
earth_selected_number <- NA_integer_
earth_selected_files <- "none"
earth_peak_speed <- NA_real_
earth_min_speed <- NA_real_
earth_display_grid <- "n/a"
earth_particle_count <- 0L
earth_speed_colour_cap_m_s <- 0.20
earth_speed_colours <- c(
  "#000078", "#0000BB", "#0000FF", "#0C3AFC", "#1975FA", "#25B0F7",
  "#32EBF5", "#73EEE6", "#B4F1D7", "#F5F5C8", "#F5F564", "#F5E032",
  "#F6CC00", "#F7A300", "#F97A00", "#FB5100", "#FF0000", "#DA0006",
  "#B5000D", "#910014", "#7B003D", "#660066", "#88008C", "#AB00B2",
  "#CD00D8", "#F000FF", "#CAA6DE", "#DBA7DD", "#EDA9D2"
)

earth_mit_notice <- paste(
  "The MIT License (MIT)",
  "Copyright (c) 2014 Cameron Beccario",
  "Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the Software), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:",
  "The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software.",
  "THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED AS IS, WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM, OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE SOFTWARE.",
  sep = "\n\n"
)

matrix_as_rows <- function(z) {
  unname(lapply(seq_len(nrow(z)), function(k) as.numeric(z[k, ])))
}

earth_west <- min(model_outline_ll_xy[, 1]); earth_east <- max(model_outline_ll_xy[, 1])
earth_south <- min(model_outline_ll_xy[, 2]); earth_north <- max(model_outline_ll_xy[, 2])
earth_x_pad <- (earth_east - earth_west) * 0.04
earth_y_pad <- (earth_north - earth_south) * 0.04
earth_bounds <- list(
  c(earth_south - earth_y_pad, earth_west - earth_x_pad),
  c(earth_north + earth_y_pad, earth_east + earth_x_pad)
)
earth_max_x_pad <- (earth_east - earth_west) * 0.50
earth_max_y_pad <- (earth_north - earth_south) * 0.50
earth_max_bounds <- list(
  c(earth_south - earth_max_y_pad, earth_west - earth_max_x_pad),
  c(earth_north + earth_max_y_pad, earth_east + earth_max_x_pad)
)
earth_outline_latlng <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(model_outline_ll_xy)), function(k) {
  unname(as.numeric(model_outline_ll_xy[k, c(2, 1)]))
})
earth_source_latlng <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(source_line_ll_xy)), function(k) {
  unname(as.numeric(source_line_ll_xy[k, c(2, 1)]))
})
earth_buoy_latlng <- unname(as.numeric(c(crds(buoy_ll)[1, 2], crds(buoy_ll)[1, 1])))

if (length(earth_common_numbers)) {
  earth_selected_number <- tail(earth_common_numbers, 1)
  earth_selected_files <- paste0("Umean_", sprintf("%05d", earth_selected_number),
                                 ", Vmean_", sprintf("%05d", earth_selected_number))
  earth_u_path <- earth_u_paths[match(earth_selected_number, earth_u_numbers)]
  earth_v_path <- earth_v_paths[match(earth_selected_number, earth_v_numbers)]
  earth_u_native <- apply_current_display_mask_model(
    read_text_model(earth_u_path, basename(earth_u_path))
  )
  earth_v_native <- apply_current_display_mask_model(
    read_text_model(earth_v_path, basename(earth_v_path))
  )
  earth_smoothed <- smooth_mean_current_components(earth_u_native, earth_v_native)
  earth_u_native <- earth_smoothed$u
  earth_v_native <- earth_smoothed$v
  # This is a depth-integrated mean-current momentum-flux proxy, h |U| U.
  # It deliberately omits density and wave radiation stress, which cannot be
  # reconstructed from a single Umean/Vmean record. Its direction is therefore
  # the mean-current direction, while depth and speed reweight its magnitude.
  earth_depth_native <- max_water_depth_model
  earth_depth_native[!current_display_mask_model] <- NA_real_
  earth_native_speed <- sqrt(earth_u_native^2 + earth_v_native^2)
  earth_flux_u_native <- earth_depth_native * earth_native_speed * earth_u_native
  earth_flux_v_native <- earth_depth_native * earth_native_speed * earth_v_native

  # Use the same compact public x/y resolution as the map products. The
  # current field remains a model-derived display; station files remain exact
  # native grid-point outputs with no interpolation.
  earth_u_public_om <- apply_current_display_mask_rotated(
    make_public_output_rotated(
      model_to_rotated_raster(earth_u_native, basename(earth_u_path))
    )
  )
  earth_v_public_om <- apply_current_display_mask_rotated(
    make_public_output_rotated(
      model_to_rotated_raster(earth_v_native, basename(earth_v_path))
    )
  )
  earth_u_public <- rotated_raster_to_model_xy(earth_u_public_om)
  earth_v_public <- rotated_raster_to_model_xy(earth_v_public_om)
  earth_valid <- is.finite(earth_u_public) & is.finite(earth_v_public)
  earth_u_public[!earth_valid] <- NA_real_
  earth_v_public[!earth_valid] <- NA_real_
  earth_flux_u_public_om <- apply_current_display_mask_rotated(
    make_public_output_rotated(
      model_to_rotated_raster(earth_flux_u_native, "mean-current momentum-flux proxy x")
    )
  )
  earth_flux_v_public_om <- apply_current_display_mask_rotated(
    make_public_output_rotated(
      model_to_rotated_raster(earth_flux_v_native, "mean-current momentum-flux proxy y")
    )
  )
  earth_flux_u_public <- rotated_raster_to_model_xy(earth_flux_u_public_om)
  earth_flux_v_public <- rotated_raster_to_model_xy(earth_flux_v_public_om)
  earth_flux_valid <- is.finite(earth_flux_u_public) & is.finite(earth_flux_v_public)
  earth_flux_u_public[!earth_flux_valid] <- NA_real_
  earth_flux_v_public[!earth_flux_valid] <- NA_real_
  earth_speed <- sqrt(earth_u_public^2 + earth_v_public^2)
  earth_valid_speed <- earth_speed[is.finite(earth_speed) & earth_speed > 0]
  earth_peak_speed <- if (length(earth_valid_speed)) max(earth_valid_speed) else NA_real_
  earth_flux_speed <- sqrt(earth_flux_u_public^2 + earth_flux_v_public^2)
  earth_valid_flux_speed <- earth_flux_speed[is.finite(earth_flux_speed) & earth_flux_speed > 0]
  earth_flux_colour_cap <- if (length(earth_valid_flux_speed)) {
    max(1e-6, as.numeric(stats::quantile(earth_valid_flux_speed, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)))
  } else {
    1e-6
  }
  earth_flux_min_speed <- if (length(earth_valid_flux_speed)) {
    max(1e-7, 0.01 * as.numeric(stats::quantile(earth_valid_flux_speed, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)))
  } else {
    Inf
  }
  earth_min_speed <- if (length(earth_valid_speed)) {
    max(0.0005, 0.01 * as.numeric(stats::quantile(earth_valid_speed, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)))
  } else {
    Inf
  }
  earth_display_dx_m <- grid$dx_m[1] * public_output_factor_x
  earth_display_dy_m <- grid$dy_m[1] * public_output_factor_y
  earth_display_grid <- paste0(metres_label(earth_display_dx_m), " m x ",
                               metres_label(earth_display_dy_m), " m")

  # A local Oblique Mercator grid is effectively affine across this small
  # domain. Passing its four geographic corners lets the browser render the
  # vector field in WGS84 while interpolation and particle advection remain
  # in FUNWAVE's x/y coordinate system.
  earth_native_corners <- rbind(
    c(0, 0),
    c((grid$Mglob[1] - 1) * grid$dx_m[1], 0),
    c((grid$Mglob[1] - 1) * grid$dx_m[1], (grid$Nglob[1] - 1) * grid$dy_m[1]),
    c(0, (grid$Nglob[1] - 1) * grid$dy_m[1])
  )
  earth_corner_ll <- model_xy_to_wgs84(earth_native_corners)
  earth_corner_latlng <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(earth_corner_ll)), function(k) {
    unname(as.numeric(earth_corner_ll[k, c(2, 1)]))
  })
  # This uses a canvas, so a dense, domain-wide set of trajectories remains
  # responsive.  The particles are seeded throughout valid display cells.
  earth_particle_count <- 5400L
  earth_data <- list(
    bounds = earth_bounds,
    max_bounds = earth_max_bounds,
    outline = earth_outline_latlng,
    source = earth_source_latlng,
    buoy = earth_buoy_latlng,
    corners = earth_corner_latlng,
    fields = list(
      current = list(
        u = matrix_as_rows(earth_u_public), v = matrix_as_rows(earth_v_public),
        min_speed = earth_min_speed, colour_cap = earth_speed_colour_cap_m_s,
        label = "Mean-current speed (m/s)"
      ),
      momentum_flux = list(
        u = matrix_as_rows(earth_flux_u_public), v = matrix_as_rows(earth_flux_v_public),
        min_speed = earth_flux_min_speed, colour_cap = earth_flux_colour_cap,
        label = "Depth-integrated mean-current momentum-flux proxy (m3/s2)"
      )
    ),
    nx = nrow(earth_u_public), ny = ncol(earth_u_public),
    dx_m = earth_display_dx_m, dy_m = earth_display_dy_m,
    min_speed_m_s = earth_min_speed,
    max_speed_m_s = ifelse(is.finite(earth_peak_speed), earth_peak_speed, 0),
    particle_count = earth_particle_count,
    speed_colour_cap_m_s = earth_speed_colour_cap_m_s,
    speed_colours = unname(earth_speed_colours),
    model_time_label = paste0("Latest smoothed FUNWAVE Umean/Vmean output; ",
                              metres_label(grid$mean_wave_interval_s[1]),
                              " s averaging interval; ", current_smoothing_label,
                              ". Choose one field in the layer control."),
    credit = "Particle animator adapted from Cameron Beccario's earth (MIT).",
    mit_notice = earth_mit_notice
  )
  earth_js <- paste0(
    "function(el, x, data) {",
    "/* Adapted from earth.js in cambecc/earth. Copyright (c) 2014 Cameron Beccario; MIT notice supplied in data.mit_notice. */",
    "var map=this;if(!map||typeof map.getPanes!=='function')map=this.map||this._map;",
    "if(!map||typeof map.getPanes!=='function'){console.error('Leaflet map was not available for Earth-style particles');return;}",
    "document.documentElement.style.height='100%';document.body.style.margin='0';document.body.style.height='100%';el.style.width='100vw';el.style.height='100vh';",
    "var bounds=L.latLngBounds(data.bounds),maxBounds=L.latLngBounds(data.max_bounds||data.bounds),fields=data.fields||{},activeField='current',u=(fields.current||{}).u||[],v=(fields.current||{}).v||[],nx=data.nx,ny=data.ny;",
    "function finite(z){return typeof z==='number'&&isFinite(z);}",
    "function bilerp(a,b,c,d,fx,fy){return a*(1-fx)*(1-fy)+b*fx*(1-fy)+c*(1-fx)*fy+d*fx*fy;}",
    "function vectorAt(px,py){if(!(px>=0&&py>=0&&px<nx-1&&py<ny-1))return null;var i=Math.floor(px),j=Math.floor(py),fx=px-i,fy=py-j;var u00=u[i][j],u10=u[i+1][j],u01=u[i][j+1],u11=u[i+1][j+1],v00=v[i][j],v10=v[i+1][j],v01=v[i][j+1],v11=v[i+1][j+1];if(!finite(u00)||!finite(u10)||!finite(u01)||!finite(u11)||!finite(v00)||!finite(v10)||!finite(v01)||!finite(v11))return null;var ux=bilerp(u00,u10,u01,u11,fx,fy),vy=bilerp(v00,v10,v01,v11,fx,fy);return {u:ux,v:vy,m:Math.sqrt(ux*ux+vy*vy)};}",
    "function modelToLatLng(px,py){var fx=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,px/(nx-1))),fy=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,py/(ny-1))),c=data.corners;return [bilerp(c[0][0],c[1][0],c[3][0],c[2][0],fx,fy),bilerp(c[0][1],c[1][1],c[3][1],c[2][1],fx,fy)];}",
    "var osm=L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',{attribution:'&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'});",
    "var satellite=L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',{attribution:'Tiles &copy; Esri'}).addTo(map);if(map.hasLayer(osm))map.removeLayer(osm);if(!map.hasLayer(satellite))satellite.addTo(map);",
    "var grid=L.polyline(data.outline,{color:'black',weight:2}),paddle=L.polyline(data.source,{color:'dodgerblue',weight:2,dashArray:'6 6'}),buoy=L.circleMarker(data.buoy,{radius:5,color:'red',fillOpacity:1});",
    "grid.addTo(map);paddle.addTo(map);buoy.addTo(map);map.fitBounds(bounds,{padding:[4,4]});map.setMaxBounds(maxBounds);",
    "function panel(position,text){var c=L.control({position:position});c.onAdd=function(){var d=L.DomUtil.create('div');d.style.background='rgba(255,255,255,.92)';d.style.padding='6px 8px';d.style.font='12px/1.3 Arial';d.style.whiteSpace='pre-line';d.style.width='min(250px,calc(100vw - 44px))';d.style.maxWidth='250px';d.style.maxHeight='min(110px,calc(100vh - 150px))';d.style.overflow='auto';d.style.boxSizing='border-box';d.style.marginBottom='24px';d.textContent=text;return d;};c.addTo(map);return c;}",
    "panel('bottomleft',data.model_time_label+'\\nDisplay grid: '+data.dx_m+' m x '+data.dy_m+' m\\nThe momentum option is h |U| U, a mean-current proxy rather than wave radiation stress.');map.attributionControl.addAttribution(data.credit);",
    "var MAX_PARTICLE_AGE=160,DISPLAY_TIME_SCALE=24000,particleCount=Math.max(450,Number(data.particle_count)||5400);",
    "var EarthFlowLayer=L.Layer.extend({initialize:function(){this._running=false;this._particles=[];},onAdd:function(m){this._map=m;this._canvas=L.DomUtil.create('canvas','leaflet-zoom-animated',m.getPanes().overlayPane);this._canvas.style.pointerEvents='none';this._canvas.style.zIndex=650;this._resize();m.on('resize moveend zoomend',this._resize,this);for(var k=0;k<particleCount;k++)this._particles.push(this._randomize({age:Math.random()*MAX_PARTICLE_AGE},k));this._running=true;this._last=performance.now();this._frame=window.requestAnimationFrame(this._animate.bind(this));},onRemove:function(m){this._running=false;window.cancelAnimationFrame(this._frame);m.off('resize moveend zoomend',this._resize,this);L.DomUtil.remove(this._canvas);this._map=null;},_resize:function(){if(!this._map||!this._canvas)return;var s=this._map.getSize(),d=window.devicePixelRatio||1;this._canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(s.x*d));this._canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(s.y*d));this._canvas.style.width=s.x+'px';this._canvas.style.height=s.y+'px';this._topLeft=this._map.containerPointToLayerPoint([0,0]);L.DomUtil.setPosition(this._canvas,this._topLeft);this._ctx=this._canvas.getContext('2d');this._ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);},_randomize:function(p,slot){var initial=Number.isInteger(slot),side=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(particleCount));for(var n=0;n<1600;n++){if(initial){var q=(slot+n*997)%particleCount,col=q%side,row=Math.floor(q/side);p.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(nx-1,((col+.5+.25*(Math.random()-.5))/side)*(nx-1)));p.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(ny-1,((row+.5+.25*(Math.random()-.5))/side)*(ny-1)));}else{p.x=Math.random()*(nx-1);p.y=Math.random()*(ny-1);}var w=vectorAt(p.x,p.y);if(w&&w.m>=data.min_speed_m_s){p.age=Math.random()*MAX_PARTICLE_AGE;return p;}}p.age=MAX_PARTICLE_AGE+1;return p;},_colour:function(m){var   earth_widget <- leaflet::leaflet(
    width = "100vw", height = "100vh",
    options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom = 12, maxZoom = 18, maxBoundsViscosity = 1)
  )
  earth_widget <- htmlwidgets::onRender(earth_widget, earth_js, data = earth_data)
  earth_flow_page_status <- tryCatch({
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(earth_widget, earth_flow_page_path, selfcontained = TRUE)
    if (!file.exists(earth_flow_page_path) || file.info(earth_flow_page_path)$size < 5000) {
      stop("The Earth-style mean-current page was not written or is unexpectedly small.")
    }
    paste0("Published from Umean/Vmean file ", sprintf("%05d", earth_selected_number),
           "; peak mean speed ", format(round(earth_peak_speed, 3), nsmall = 3), " m/s.")
  }, error = function(e) {
    paste0("Earth-style flow page write failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}

if (!file.exists(earth_flow_page_path)) {
  earth_fallback <- paste(
    "The Earth-style mean-current particle page could not be animated for this run.",
    paste0("Umean files found: ", length(earth_u_paths)),
    paste0("Vmean files found: ", length(earth_v_paths)),
    paste0("Paired mean-current fields: ", length(earth_common_numbers)),
    paste0("Status: ", earth_flow_page_status),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  earth_fallback_saved <- tryCatch({
    htmltools::save_html(
      htmltools::tags$html(
        htmltools::tags$head(htmltools::tags$title("Port Fairy Earth-style mean-current diagnostics")),
        htmltools::tags$body(
          style = "font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 58rem; margin: 3rem auto; line-height: 1.45;",
          htmltools::tags$h1("Port Fairy Earth-style mean-current diagnostics"),
          htmltools::tags$p("No animated mean-current field was available for this model run."),
          htmltools::tags$pre(earth_fallback)
        )
      ),
      file = earth_flow_page_path
    )
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    earth_flow_page_status <<- paste0(earth_flow_page_status,
                                      " Fallback page write failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    FALSE
  })
  if (earth_fallback_saved) {
    earth_flow_page_status <- paste0(earth_flow_page_status,
                                     " A diagnostic page was published instead.")
  }
}

earth_flow_debug <- data.frame(
  Diagnostic = c("Umean field files found", "Vmean field files found",
                 "Paired Umean/Vmean fields", "Selected file(s)",
                 "Mean-current display grid", "Peak mean speed (m/s)",
                 "Earth-style mean-current page"),
  Value = c(length(earth_u_paths), length(earth_v_paths), length(earth_common_numbers),
            earth_selected_files, earth_display_grid,
            ifelse(is.finite(earth_peak_speed), format(round(earth_peak_speed, 3), nsmall = 3), "n/a"),
            earth_flow_page_status),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# A single fixed range makes every eta frame and map comparable across days.
eta_animation_limits <- eta_display_limits

# Both animations are conventional six-second looping GIFs. Their frame
# intervals adapt to the number of saved outputs.
gif_duration_s <- 6
# eta_00000 is the zero-time initial condition, not an evolved model state.
# It is retained in eta_max but deliberately excluded from the full GIF.
full_animation_indices <- which(eta_time > 0)
full_gif_interval <- gif_duration_s / max(1, length(full_animation_indices))
final_sixth_indices <- which(eta_time >= final_sixth_start_s)
final_sixth_gif_interval <- gif_duration_s / max(1, length(final_sixth_indices))
full_animation_saved_start_label <- if (length(full_animation_indices)) {
  elapsed_clock(min(eta_time[full_animation_indices]))
} else {
  "n/a"
}
full_animation_saved_end_label <- if (length(full_animation_indices)) {
  elapsed_clock(max(eta_time[full_animation_indices]))
} else {
  "n/a"
}
final_sixth_saved_start_label <- if (length(final_sixth_indices)) {
  elapsed_clock(min(eta_time[final_sixth_indices]))
} else {
  "n/a"
}
final_sixth_saved_end_label <- if (length(final_sixth_indices)) {
  elapsed_clock(max(eta_time[final_sixth_indices]))
} else {
  "n/a"
}

# Write real GIF files before the HTML is assembled. This is more reliable than
# Knitr's animation hook, which can leave an empty figure placeholder when the
# report is moved to the Pages output directory.
site_assets_dir <- file.path(report_site_dir, "assets")
dir.create(site_assets_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
full_gif_url <- "assets/port-fairy-full.gif"
final_sixth_gif_url <- "assets/port-fairy-final-sixth.gif"

draw_eta_frame <- function(k) {
  r_om <- eta_public_frames[[k]]
  r_ll <- project(r_om, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
  r_ll <- apply_water_masks_wgs84(r_ll)
  plot_geographic(r_ll,
                  main = sprintf("Free-surface elevation: t = %.1f s (WGS84)", eta_time[k]),
                  col = eta_animation_palette,
                  range = eta_animation_limits, show_legend = TRUE,
                  animation = TRUE)
  add_wave_frame_annotation(r_ll, eta_time[k])
}

write_eta_gif <- function(indices, file_name, interval) {
  if (!length(indices)) return(NULL)
  gif_path <- file.path(site_assets_dir, file_name)
  gifski::save_gif(
    expr = for (k in indices) draw_eta_frame(k),
    gif_file = gif_path, width = 960, height = 720, res = 110,
    delay = interval, loop = TRUE, progress = FALSE
  )
  if (!file.exists(gif_path) || file.info(gif_path)$size < 1000) {
    stop("GIF was not written: ", gif_path)
  }
  gif_path
}

full_gif_path <- write_eta_gif(full_animation_indices, "port-fairy-full.gif",
                               full_gif_interval)
final_sixth_gif_path <- write_eta_gif(final_sixth_indices,
                                      "port-fairy-final-sixth.gif",
                                      final_sixth_gif_interval)
```

## Interpretation first

This is a `r paste0(metres_label(grid$dx_m[1]), " m")`, `r simulation_label`
grid and forcing diagnostic—not a validated harbour forecast. Each raw
FUNWAVE text field is first rebuilt on the exact rotated Oblique Mercator grid,
then masked seaward of the internal wavemaker. Beach visibility is derived on
that native grid from the AHD DEM and the greatest saved positive eta, so cells
that wet above MSL are retained before any WGS84 projection. The
historical workflow publishes report maps, animations and GeoTIFFs at
`r paste0(public_grid_tag, " cells")` in that rotated CRS, then reprojects them
to WGS84 for geographic display. Current paths remain traced on native model
cells before being projected to WGS84. Interactive maps start on the local
domain but can zoom out to roughly twice its span; current-animation pages
use the full browser viewport and offer a full-screen button.

Live report: <https://julianog.github.io/run_surf_wave_forecast/>. Source:
<https://github.com/JulianOG/run_surf_wave_forecast>.

```{r forcing-status}
direction_status <- if (forcing$inward_source_component > 0) {
  "The wave vector has an inward component from the selected source edge."
} else {
  "Warning: the wave vector points out of the selected source edge. Do not interpret this run as a coastal-wave prediction."
}
report_table(transpose_summary(data.frame(
  source_edge = grid$source_edge,
  boundary_direction_statistic = forcing$boundary_direction_statistic,
  requested_model_x_bearing_deg_true = forcing$requested_model_x_bearing_deg_true,
  realised_model_x_bearing_deg_true = forcing$model_x_bearing_deg_true,
  funwave_theta_peak_deg = forcing$funwave_theta_peak_deg,
  inward_source_component = forcing$inward_source_component,
  map_water_visibility = display_water_mask_label,
  interpretation = direction_status
), digits = 2))
```

## Latest buoy forcing

The irregular `WK_IRR` source is a TMA/JONSWAP-style parameterisation made from
the newest usable IMOS Spotter observation. It uses the buoy **mean** direction
and matching mean directional spread when present (`SSWMD` and `WMDS`), falling
back to the peak values only when the mean values are unavailable. The buoy
provides integral Hs and period parameters—not a phase-resolved spectrum.

```{r forcing}
report_table(transpose_summary(forcing, digits = 2))
```

```{r historical-observed-conditions-heading, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (historical_observation_available) {
  cat(paste0("## Observed conditions around this ", observation_context_label, "\n\n"))
  if (observation_is_historical) {
    cat(
      "This interactive context shows QC 1/2 Port Fairy buoy Hs, Tp and wave direction, ",
      "together with hourly Portland water level converted from assumed LAT to AHD, ",
      "for seven days either side of the requested historical time. The red diamond ",
      "marks the measurement used to force FUNWAVE; it may precede the requested time ",
      "because historical forcing never uses a future observation.\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  } else {
    cat(
      "This interactive context shows QC 1/2 Port Fairy buoy Hs, Tp and wave direction, ",
      "together with hourly Portland water level converted from assumed LAT to AHD, ",
      "for the seven days ending at the latest available forecast forcing record. The red ",
      "diamond marks the measurement applied to FUNWAVE.\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
}
```

Each observed-variable panel carries its own Port Fairy local-time axis, so the
timing of waves and water levels can be compared without relying on a shared
bottom axis. The orange dashed line in the Portland panel is the mean of annual
hourly maxima from sufficiently complete local years in the selected UHSLC file.

## Latest free-surface elevation

This map is the final saved instantaneous free-surface displacement, `eta`, and
is not a wave-height map. Its layer control includes the model's positive-water-
depth bathymetry, which can be viewed alone by turning off **Model output**.

```{r eta, echo=FALSE}
if (is.null(eta)) {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No eta output was produced.")
} else {
  eta_plot <- apply_output_visibility_mask_model(eta)
  eta_rotated <- model_to_rotated_raster(eta_plot, "eta")
  eta_wgs84 <- write_model_output_rasters(eta_rotated, "eta_latest")
  eta_wgs84 <- apply_water_masks_wgs84(eta_wgs84)
  writeRaster(eta_wgs84, file.path(case_dir, "eta_latest_wgs84.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  bathymetry_wgs84 <- project(depth_raster, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
  bathymetry_limit <- terra::global(depth_raster, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  leaflet_model_map(eta_wgs84, eta_animation_palette,
                    eta_display_limits, "Free-surface\nelevation (m)",
                    bathymetry_r_ll = bathymetry_wgs84,
                    bathymetry_palette = ygnbu_palette,
                    bathymetry_limits = c(0, bathymetry_limit))
}
```

## Free-surface animations

Both GIFs use a shared colour scale and are written as standalone assets from
this Rmd, after each raw output has been reconstructed on the rotated FUNWAVE
grid and projected to WGS84. The zero-time initial condition is
intentionally omitted from the full animation. Each GIF loops for six seconds:
one represents the complete `r simulation_label` run (saved frames
`r full_animation_saved_start_label`--`r full_animation_saved_end_label`), and
the other shows the final one-sixth (configured `r final_sixth_start_label`--`r simulation_end_label`;
saved frames `r final_sixth_saved_start_label`--`r final_sixth_saved_end_label`).

The fixed −5 to 5 m YlGnBu colour range makes colours comparable among frames
and between the two animations. The legend and source/buoy key are drawn inside
the enlarged animation frame rather than in its clipped outer margin.

### Full `r simulation_label` simulation: saved `r full_animation_saved_start_label`--`r full_animation_saved_end_label`

This animation shows the development from the first evolved model output to the
last saved model time. It is a visual compression of the simulation timeline,
so the six-second playback rate is not physical wave celerity.

```{r eta-animation-full}
if (is.null(full_gif_path)) {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No evolved eta output was produced.")
} else {
  htmltools::tags$img(src = full_gif_url, alt = "Full Port Fairy free-surface animation",
                       style = "max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block;")
}
```

### Final one-sixth: saved `r final_sixth_saved_start_label`--`r final_sixth_saved_end_label`

This animation isolates the final sixth of the run, after the initial forcing
adjustment has passed. It uses the same spatial extent and colour scale as the
full simulation so features can be compared directly.

```{r eta-animation-final-sixth}
if (is.null(final_sixth_gif_path)) {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No final-one-sixth eta output was produced.")
} else {
  htmltools::tags$img(src = final_sixth_gif_url,
                       alt = "Final one-sixth Port Fairy free-surface animation",
                       style = "max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block;")
}
```

## Maximum free-surface elevation

This is the maximum positive instantaneous `eta` at each cell. It is useful for
seeing crest reach, but it is **not** a wave-height statistic.

```{r hmax-eta, echo=FALSE}
if (is.null(eta_max)) {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No eta output was produced.")
} else {
  eta_max_wgs84 <- write_model_output_rasters(eta_max, "eta_max", already_public = TRUE)
  eta_max_wgs84 <- apply_water_masks_wgs84(eta_max_wgs84)
  writeRaster(eta_max_wgs84, file.path(case_dir, "eta_max_wgs84.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  leaflet_model_map(eta_max_wgs84, ygnbu_palette,
                    eta_max_display_limits, "Maximum free-surface\nelevation (m)")
}
```

## Peak simulated significant wave height

`WaveHeight = T` is evaluated by FUNWAVE's mean-wave diagnostic after the
configured spin-up. The map below is the largest `Hsig` value at each cell from
the saved mean-wave outputs, rather than a maximum of individual `eta` frames.
Its 0–6 m colour scale is fixed so daily and historical peaks remain comparable.

```{r hsig-max, echo=FALSE}
if (is.null(hsig_max)) {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No Hsig output was produced. Check STEADY_TIME and T_INTV_mean.")
} else {
  hsig_max_wgs84 <- write_model_output_rasters(hsig_max, "hsig_max", already_public = TRUE)
  hsig_max_wgs84 <- apply_water_masks_wgs84(hsig_max_wgs84)
  writeRaster(hsig_max_wgs84, file.path(case_dir, "hsig_max_wgs84.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  leaflet_model_map(hsig_max_wgs84, ygnbu_palette,
                    hsig_display_limits, "Peak simulated\nsignificant wave height (m)")
}
```

## Data acknowledgement and citation

Buoy data were sourced from the **Integrated Marine Observing System (IMOS)**,
which is enabled by the National Collaborative Research Infrastructure Strategy
(NCRIS). The wave data were collected and quality controlled by the University
of Western Australia. This dataset is an output from the Catching Oz Waves
project, which received investment from the Australian Research Data Commons
(ARDC): <https://doi.org/10.47486/DP748>. ARDC is funded by NCRIS.

Suggested data citation: *Deakin University (year of data downloaded), Wave
buoys Observations -- Australia -- near real-time, downloaded from the IMOS URL
on the date of download.*

For historical reports, the same Port Fairy records are read from the public
AODN delayed-mode collection when available. The exact NetCDF filename used
for the model forcing and the source filename for each displayed observation
are retained in the report provenance/output files.

## Provenance

```{r provenance}
report_table(transpose_summary(grid, digits = 3))
```

## Buoy-to-nearshore eta time series

These are native FUNWAVE station outputs from five selected integer grid cells:
the buoy end is black-purple and the nearshore end is pale yellow on the Magma
scale. They are written every second from the model state—there is no spatial
or temporal interpolation, and the horizontal axis is model elapsed time.

```{r station-timeseries, echo=FALSE}
if (!nrow(station_timeseries)) {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No FUNWAVE station output was produced.")
} else {
  htmltools::tags$iframe(
    src = "assets/port-fairy-transect-timeseries.html", width = "100%", height = "560",
    style = "border: 1px solid #dfe6e9; display: block;"
  )
}
```

## Animated current particles

This existing particle page now uses the latest FUNWAVE time-mean `Umean`/
`Vmean` field rather than phase-resolved `U`/`V` wave-orbital velocities. Its
paths are traced on native rotated grid cells with nearest-cell velocities,
then projected to WGS84. This removes the wave-period direction reversals that
made the particles wobble; animation speed remains visual only.

```{r current-particles, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::tags$p(
  htmltools::tags$a(
    "Open the full animated current-flow particle page",
    href = current_particle_page_url, target = "_blank",
    style = "font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600;"
  )
)
```

## Earth-style current particles

This is an additional particle renderer inspired by the open-source
[earth.nullschool.net animator](https://github.com/cambecc/earth). It uses the
same latest `Umean`/`Vmean` field as the repaired page above, but advects and
fades particles directly in the browser to give continuous trails. The
browser's bilinear field interpolation is display-only; it does not alter
FUNWAVE outputs or the exact grid-cell transect series.

```{r earth-style-current-particles, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::tags$p(
  htmltools::tags$a(
    "Open the Earth-style mean-current particle page",
    href = earth_flow_page_url, target = "_blank",
    style = "font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600;"
  )
)
report_table(earth_flow_debug)
```
